description:
Founded in 2014, Circles is a global technology company reimagining the telco industry with its innovative SaaS platform, empowering telco operators worldwide to effortlessly launch innovative digital brands or refresh existing ones, accelerating their transformation into techcos.
   

  

 Today, Circles partners with leading telco operators across multiple countries and continents, including KDDI Corporation, Etisalat Group (e\&), AT\&T, and Telkomsel, creating blueprints for future telco and digital experiences enjoyed by millions of consumers globally.
   

  

 Besides its SaaS business, Circles operates three other distinct businesses:
   

  

* Circles.Life: A wholly\-owned digital lifestyle telco brand based in Singapore, Circles.Life is powered by Circles’ SaaS platform and pioneering go\-to\-market strategies. It is the digital market leader in Singapore and has won numerous awards for marketing, customer service, and innovative product offerings beyond connectivity.
* Circles Aspire: A global provider of Communications Platform\-as\-a\-Service (CPaaS) solutions. Its cloud\-based Experience Cloud platform enables enterprises, service providers and developers to deliver and scale mobile, messaging, IoT, and connectivity services worldwide.
* Jetpac: Specializing in travel tech solutions, Jetpac provides seamless eSIM roaming for over 200 destinations and innovative travel lifestyle products, redefining connectivity for digital travelers. Jetpac was awarded Travel eSIM of the Year.


 Circles is backed by renowned global investors, including Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia), Warburg Pincus, Founders Fund, and EDBI (the investment arm of the Singapore Economic Development Board), with a track record of backing industry challengers.
   

  

**Software Engineer – Mobile (AI\-Accelerated)**
**Location: Gurugram, India (Hybrid)**
**Company: Circles.Life – Jetpac**
**Type: Full\-time**
**About Jetpac**
 Jetpac, from Circles, is building a seamless way for travelers to stay connected globally. We offer eSIMs across 200\+ destinations with a fast\-growing consumer platform spanning web, mobile, and partner channels targeting the travel essentials segment.
   

  

 We operate as a high\-velocity product team. Small teams, fast decisions, and direct ownership. We ship continuously, iterate quickly, and measure what matters.
   

  

**The Role**
 Mobile development is changing rapidly with AI\-assisted and agent\-based development workflows. At Jetpac, we expect engineers to use these tools as a core part of how they build software. As a Mobile Engineer, you will build and scale Jetpac's Android and iOS applications using React Native, while owning features end\-to\-end from product and UX understanding through development, testing, release, and iteration.
   

  

**This Role Is For Engineers Who**
* Think beyond tickets and understand the product problem
* Use AI to significantly accelerate development
* Care about UX, performance, and quality
* Take ownership of what they build


**What You'll Do \& Core Areas**
* Build and ship Android and iOS features using React Native
* Own features end\-to\-end: understand the problem, shape the solution with the team, build, test, release, and iterate
* Use AI\-assisted and agent\-based development workflows across coding, debugging, testing, and code review
* Work closely with Product and Design to build simple, polished mobile experiences
* Write and maintain automated tests, and use AI\-assisted testing workflows to improve product quality
* Identify and resolve performance, reliability, and UX issues
* Improve existing features based on product data, user feedback, and production insights
* Work closely with backend engineers to build reliable end\-to\-end experiences


**Focus Areas Include**
* React Native and cross\-platform mobile development
* Mobile UX and product experience
* AI\-accelerated development workflows
* Testing and quality
* App performance and reliability
* API integration and mobile architecture


**Required Skills And Experience**
* 2–3 years of professional mobile software development experience
* Strong experience building production applications with React Native
* Experience shipping and maintaining both Android and iOS applications
* Experience with mobile APIs, state management, navigation, and native device capabilities
* Strong understanding of mobile performance, debugging, and automated testing
* Experience working with REST APIs and backend services
* Comfortable with Git, CI/CD, and modern development workflows
* Hands\-on experience using AI\-assisted or agent\-based development workflows
* Ability to review, debug, test, and improve AI\-generated code, not just generate it
* Some experience on UX principles and mobile interaction patterns


 Example Projects You'll Work On
   

  

* Build new Jetpac mobile experiences across the eSIM discovery, purchase, activation, and management journey
* Improve key parts of the mobile experience to improve conversion and usability
* Build new product capabilities and integrations across the Jetpac ecosystem
* Improve app startup time, rendering performance, API efficiency, and reliability
* Build AI\-assisted workflows that accelerate feature development, testing, and debugging


 What Success Looks Like
   

  

* You ship high\-quality mobile features in days, not weeks
* You use AI to materially increase your development velocity
* You take strong ownership of implementation and contribute to getting features to production
* The app becomes faster, more reliable, and easier to use
* You improve the team's ability to build and ship mobile experiences


 Hiring Process
   

  

* HR Round
* Technical Interview with Mobile Developers
* Live Practical Assignment (build \+ explain your approach, including AI usage)
* Technical Conversation with CTO


 Why Jetpac
   

  

* High ownership, low bureaucracy
* Real product impact at global scale
* AI\-first engineering culture
* Fast\-moving team with strong engineering culture
* Flexible work setup across global teams


 Circles is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, disability or age.
   

  

**Data Protection and Privacy Statement**
 By submitting an application for this position, you, as the applicant, or your authorised representative(s), consent to
 **Circles’ Candidate Data Protection and Privacy Policy.** 
 You also agree to the collection, use, and/or disclosure of your personal data by us solely for recruitment purposes as specified in the Policy. You acknowledge that you have read and understood the Policy, are aware of your rights regarding your personal data, and accept the terms relating to international data transfers, where applicable. You further understand that you may withdraw consent at any time, which may affect our ability to consider your application. In instances where your personal data or application is submitted by a third party, it is understood that such third party has been duly authorised by you to disclose the relevant personal data and provide consent on your behalf, and that you have been made aware of this Policy.
   

  

 To all recruitment agencies: Circles will only acknowledge resumes shared by recruitment agencies if selected in our preferred supplier partnership program.
   

  

 Please do not forward resumes to our jobs alias, Circles, employees or any other company location. Circles will not be held accountable for any fees related to unsolicited resumes not uploaded via our ATS.

PayFort is regional expert in payment processing technology and solutions across major markets in the GCC \& Levant countries, operating in UAE, Egypt, Saudi Arabia, Lebanon, Jordan and Qatar.
   

  

**Primary Responsibilities**

You will be responsible for driving the team’s technical direction, strategizing and shaping our long\-term vision and architecture. You will own major deliverables end\-to\-end, drive roadmaps, and provide technical leadership to the engineering team. If you're excited by cloud computing, designing highly scalable, fault tolerant systems, and want to be challenged by the toughest computer science problems, then join us to build the next generation distributed systems solving big data problems.

The candidate should have strong distributed systems and web services design and implementation experience, as well as experience working on high availability production systems.

* Project management \- prioritization , planning of projects and features, Stakeholder management and tracking of external commitments

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience

**Preferred Qualifications**
* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

description:
**Company Overview**
 KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice\-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R\&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem\-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.
   

  

**Group/Division**
 With over 40 years of semiconductor process control experience, chipmakers around the globe rely on KLA to ensure that their fabs ramp next\-generation devices to volume production quickly and cost\-effectively. Enabling the movement towards advanced chip design, KLA's Global Products Group (GPG), which is responsible for creating all of KLA’s metrology and inspection products, is looking for the best and the brightest research scientist, software engineers, application development engineers, and senior product technology process engineers. The Surfscan group includes a team of engineers, technology development, apps engineers and product marketing focused on technology that enables wafer, IC and equipment manufacturers to develop, qualify and monitor their process tools. Defects and process non\-uniformities detected on Surfscan equipment allow for early identification of yield excursions. The flagship Surfscan products include the SPx platforms for wafer surface quality and wafer defect inspection tools and systems for inspection of polished wafers, epi wafers and engineered substrates during the wafer fabrication process.
   

  

**Job Description/Preferred Qualifications**
**Role** 
 :
   

  

 Lead Software Engineer position to work on SFS division's SPx products based on Common software platform.
   

  

**Essential Responsibilities:**
* Acquire and demonstrate technical knowledge of Surfscan software.
* Be the technology evangelist for Surfscan product division
* Works on complex problems where analysis of situations or data requires an in\-depth evaluation of various factors.
* Ensuring that detailed designs, code, and unit tests, are consistent, robust, future\-proof and scalable.
* Understand and make design and architectural improvements on existing software.
* Participate in requirements definition and review process. Provide Technical assessment of the impact of any changes to product requirements.
* Providing technical expertise to the estimation process as input to the project plan
* Acquire knowledge of key use cases in Bare wafer inspection (IC \& Wafer customers)
* Follow KT defined software development processes
* Lead small teams to develop key features on need basis.
* In conjunction with the Technical Manager, identify, highlight, review and mitigate technical risks
* Contributes to the continued improvement of the organization’s development procedures, by looking for opportunities for improvement and proposing ideas for solutions.
* Stay up to date with new technologies and methodologies that can enhance architecture, user experience, or development processes.
* Drive the architecture and technical design of various components within the platform.


- 

**Qualifications** 
 :
   

  

 Bachelor's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 6\+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products
   

  

 (Or)
   

  

 Master's degree in Computer science / Electronics / Electrical or equivalent field with 4\+ years of experience with large software systems and/or semiconductor products
   

  

**Requirements** 
 :
   

  

* Strong in programming fundamentals, C\#, C\+\+, COM.
* Experience in Architecting systems from scratch, leading project teams.
* Diverse Experience in analysis, design, development, and unit testing
* Thorough knowledge of SDLC and software engineering
* Experience in developing enterprise applications in .NET/C\# using object\-oriented concepts.
* Proficiency in object\-oriented development principles, and relational database design patterns.
* Must be able to interact and communicate with all levels of staff and project management in both the business and the technical areas, with the ability to keep discussions at the appropriate level of abstraction.
* Possess excellent analytical, problem solving, organizational, interpersonal, and motivational skills, with the ability to move cleanly from theoretical to implementation thinking.
* Willingness to travel to US and other customer places on short assignments.


**Preferred Experience:**
* Experience in developing COM/DCOM using MFC/ATL
* Experience in .Net and C\#.
* Knowledge in STL, Boost Library, WinDBG and Windows Internals.
* Knowledge of CMM or other process models
* Knowledge of KT specific or general semiconductor domain


**Minimum Qualifications**
 Master's Level Degree , Bachelor's Level Degree or work experience of 1 years

In most instances, this position requires in\-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
   

  

**Minimum qualifications:**
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 5 years of experience with android systems and applications, with managing issues and research across Android.
* Experience with Graphics Processing Unit (GPU)\-level programming.


**Preferred qualifications:**
* 8 years of experience with android systems and applications, with managing issues and research across Android.
* Experience with mobile and desktop gaming.
* Ability to build performant, and secure systems.
* Excellent technical communication and collaboration skills.


**About The Job**
 Google's software engineers develop the next\-generation technologies that change how billions of users connect, explore, and interact with information and one another. Our products need to handle information at massive scale, and extend well beyond web search. We're looking for engineers who bring fresh ideas from all areas, including information retrieval, distributed computing, large\-scale system design, networking and data storage, security, artificial intelligence, natural language processing, UI design and mobile; the list goes on and is growing every day. As a software engineer, you will work on a specific project critical to Google’s needs with opportunities to switch teams and projects as you and our fast\-paced business grow and evolve. We need our engineers to be versatile, display leadership qualities and be enthusiastic to take on new problems across the full\-stack as we continue to push technology forward.
   

  

 Our team is responsible for delivering a quality gaming experience allowing the users to play their Android and native games across form factors.
   

  

 In this role, you will manage cross\-system integration and performance tests across the operating system (e.g., input, graphics, audio, etc.). You will help the small team move at a pace to hit deadlines.
   

  

 Google Play offers music, movies, books, apps and games for devices, powered by the cloud. It syncs across devices and on the web. As part of the Android and Mobile team, Googlers working on Google Play do everything from engineering our backend systems, to shaping product strategy, to forming great content partnerships. They make it possible for people to do things like buy an ebook or song on their Android phone, then have it instantly available on their laptop. The Google Play team enhances the Android ecosystem by giving developers and partners a premium store where they can reach millions of users.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Design and implement features to ensure a performant, reliable multi\-platform gameplay experience to delight the users.
* Write and review code, design docs, and test plans to ensure quality work.
* Partner with product management, program management, and User Experience (UX) to solve problems and deliver business impact.
* Solve problems that balance technical considerations (e.g., maintainability, scalability, reliability, availability, efficiency, security) with business/product requirements.
* Work on software development, deployment and production practices.


 Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

 ﻿
 
 We are seeking Automation engineer with strong experience in mobile app automation , website and POS automation. This role will focus on building and maintaining automation frameworks that validate end\-to\-end customer ordering workflows across mobile apps, websites, and POS systems. The ideal candidate combines software engineering skills with QA automation expertise and has hands\-on experience automating iOS, Android, web applications, and device\-integrated systems.

* **Mobile applications (iOS and Android)**
* **Websites and ordering portals**
* **POS workflows**
* Build mobile automation test suites using Appium

* Automate POS ordering workflows and store integrations
* Create API automation tests for backend services
* Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Maintain automation stability, reliability, and execution speed
* Collaborate with developers, product teams, and DevOps engineers
* Participate in test strategy, test design, and automation planning



  





**Required Skills** 




  




* 5–8 years of QA automation or SDET experience

* Java
* JavaScript / TypeScript
* Python
* Groovy
* Hands\-on experience automating:
* Mobile apps (iOS and Android)
* Web applications
* POS workflows or device\-based systems
* Experience with:
* Appium (mobile automation)
* Playwright or Selenium (web automation)
* Jmeter or any performance testing tools
* Api testing
* Experience with API automation
* Experience integrating tests into CI/CD pipelines
* Familiarity with automation framework design patterns (POM, modular frameworks)



  





**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience testing digital ordering platforms or retail/QSR systems
* Experience with React Native mobile apps
* Experience using device farms (Browser Stack, AWS Device Farm)
* Knowledge of Git\-based development workflows
* Familiarity with MCP\-style test design and automation workflows
* Experience using Generative AI tools for automation development

**Nice\-to\-Have Domain Experience** 



* POS systems and store ordering workflows

* End\-to\-end order lifecycle validation
* Retail or QSR technology platforms

**Responsibilities**

 Embody our culture and values

 Certifications and/or experience in Azure Solutions, Dynamics 365, M365 Copilot and Power Platform; exposure to Azure AI services and GenAI solution patterns is a strong plus.Agile delivery, DevOps, CI/CD, and operational readiness (observability, incident response) strongly preferred—especially for AI systems.

 GoKwik is a growth operating system designed to power D2C and eCommerce brands — from checkout optimization and reducing return\-to\-origin (RTO), to payments, retention, and post\-purchase engagement. Today, GoKwik enables over 12,000 merchants worldwide, processes around $2 billion in GMV, and is strengthening its AI\-powered infrastructure.
 



 Backed by RTP Global, Z47, Peak XV, and Think Investments and bolstered by a $13 million growth round in June 2025 (total funding: $68 million), GoKwik is scaling aggressively across India, the UK, Europe, and the US.
 



  





**Why This Role Matters** 




 As GoKwik continues to expand its eCommerce enablement stack, the Implementation team plays a key role in onboarding, enabling, and empowering our merchant partners. This role is at the intersection of product, engineering, and merchant success — responsible for gathering requirements, implementing SaaS solutions, and supporting merchants with integration and product adoption. You’ll be the tech enabler who ensures merchants derive maximum value from GoKwik’s solutions.
 



  





**What You’ll Own** 




**Product Implementation \& Integration** 



* Collaborate with D2C merchants to gather requirements and create detailed Business Requirement Documents (BRDs)
* Implement GoKwik’s SaaS products across platforms like Shopify, WooCommerce, and Magento
* Support integration via APIs, SDKs, and ensure smooth onboarding and go\-live



**Technical Customer Support** 



* Serve as the technical point of contact for merchant teams during and post\-integration
* Troubleshoot implementation issues across web, iOS, and Android
* Assist with tagging tools (Google Ads, Facebook Pixels) and other analytics integrations



**Internal Collaboration \& Feedback Loops** 



* Coordinate with product, engineering, and customer success teams to improve merchant experience
* Share feedback and insights to drive product improvements and scalable processes
* Manage multiple merchant projects and prioritize work to meet business timelines



**Merchant Experience \& Enablement** 



* Deliver prompt and clear communication to technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ensure merchants are set up for long\-term success with GoKwik’s suite of products
* Monitor implementation milestones, escalate roadblocks, and ensure timely delivery



  





  





**Who You Are** 



* Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science or a related field
* 3\+ years of experience in a client\-facing Implementation Engineer or Integration Support role
* Hands\-on experience with Shopify, WooCommerce, Magento integrations
* Strong understanding of APIs, SDKs, and web technologies (HTML, CSS, JavaScript)
* Familiarity with ad tech tools like Google Ads and Facebook Pixel
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to collaborate across technical and non\-technical teams
* Strong multitasking and project management skills



  





  





**Why GoKwik** 




 At GoKwik, you're not just building tech — you're building the future of eCommerce. We work fast, solve real\-world problems, and obsess over merchant success. Our culture values speed, ownership, and continuous innovation. If you thrive in high\-growth environments, love collaborating with smart, driven people, and want to be part of a mission\-driven team, we’d love to meet you.

description:
**Job Description**
 ABOUT AMGEN
   

  

 Amgen harnesses the best of biology and technology to fight the world’s toughest diseases, and make people’s lives easier, fuller, and longer. We discover, develop, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help millions of patients. Amgen helped establish the biotechnology industry more than 40 years ago and remains on the cutting\-edge of innovation, using technology and human genetic data to push beyond what’s known today.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
 Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role we are seeking a skilled and proactive macOS/JAMF Engineer with hands\-on experience managing mobile and Apple devices using JAMF and other Mobile Device Management (MDM) solutions. This role is responsible for configuring, securing, deploying, and supporting enterprise macOS systems to ensure seamless and secure device operation across the organization. The ideal candidate will also have a solid background in automation with JAMF API, scripting and app integration to improve mobile infrastructure performance and streamline deployment processes
   

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities:**
* Administer and manage Apple devices using JAMF Pro and other MDM platforms.
* Design and implement mobile device configurations, policies, and profiles to support business needs.
* Develop automated workflows for device provisioning, software deployment, patching, and compliance checks.
* Integrate third\-party and internal applications with MDM tools for seamless app delivery and management.
* Collaborate with developers and IT teams to build or support custom scripts, APIs, and internal apps tailored for the mobile environment.
* Monitor and support mobile infrastructure to ensure high availability and performance.
* Ensure mobile devices align with corporate security and usage policies.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, including architecture, SOPs, and deployment guidelines.
* Troubleshoot and resolve issues related to mobile device deployments, applications, and integration workflows.


**What We Expect Of You**
 We are all different, yet we all use our unique contributions to serve patients. The vital attribute professional we seek is with these qualifications.
   

  

**Basic Qualifications and Experience:**
* Master's degree / bachelor’s degree and 5 to 9 years in a MacOS Engineer or Systems Administrator role


**Functional Skills:**
* Deep expertise with JAMF Pro and Apple ecosystem (macOS, iOS).
* Solid understanding of MDM tools (e.g., Intune).
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (e.g., Bash, PowerShell, Python).
* Experience building or supporting automation and app integration pipelines.
* Understanding of API integrations and mobile application deployment.
* Ability to work cross\-functionally in a fast\-paced environment with minimal direction.
* JAMF 200, 300, or higher certification.
* Familiarity with Apple Business Manager, DEP, and VPP.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools or platforms related to mobile app deployment.
* Background in enterprise macOS within regulated industries (e.g., healthcare, finance).
* Experience with security and compliance frameworks in mobile environments.


**Professional Certifications:**
* Scaled Agile Framework (SAFe) for Teams (preferred)


**Soft Skills:**
* High degree of initiative and self\-motivation.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities successfully.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Team\-oriented with a focus on achieving team goals.
* Excellent analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work effectively with global and virtual teams.


 EQUAL OPPORTUNITY STATEMENT
   

  

 Amgen is an Equal Opportunity employer and will consider you without regard to your race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability status. We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request an accommodation.

description:
About the Role   We are looking for a passionate  Data Engineer  to join our Mobile Advertising Platform engineering team. In this role, you will build highly scalable data platforms powering  Mobile Programmatic Advertising, RTB bidding systems, attribution, campaign optimization, fraud detection, and real-time analytics . You will design and implement distributed systems capable of processing  billions of mobile advertising events every day, including  ad requests, impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, in-app events, and auction logs . You'll leverage modern Big Data technologies, cloud platforms, and Generative AI to build intelligent analytics and automation solutions. 
 You'll collaborate with Product Managers, ML Engineers, Data Scientists, and Backend Engineers to build next-generation Mobile AdTech products.   What You'll Do: Design and build highly scalable data platforms capable of processing billions of mobile advertising events with low latency and high availability.  Design and build ultra-low-latency, high-throughput data pipelines processing the full mobile event funnel — ad request impression click install in-app conversion event — including OpenRTB bid request/response logging, auction analytics, and win-rate/bid-landscape reporting across multiple SSPs and ad exchanges, using Kafka, Spark Streaming, Hadoop, and Snowflake on AWS.  Architect real-time campaign pacing and budget delivery systems, applying bid optimization techniques so spend controls and bid strategy adjustments react to live auction signals within seconds.  Architect and implement real-time streaming pipelines to ingest, process, and analyze billions of advertising events including impressions, clicks, installs, conversions, and in-app events.  Design and optimize scalable ETL/ELT pipelines and data models supporting Mobile AdTech use cases such as campaign reporting, attribution, audience segmentation, fraud detection, and revenue analytics. Design large-scale Invalid Traffic (IVT) and ad fraud detection systems — click spam, install hijacking, SDK spoofing, device farms — using rules-based and ML-driven detection across billions of daily events.  Develop backend services (Java, REST APIs, JDBC) supporting DSP bidding logic, campaign management tools, and reporting APIs. 
Design and develop GenAI-powered agents for analytics, operations, and data enrichment using frameworks such as LangChain, LlamaIndex, LangGraph, or custom orchestration frameworks.  Design systems that are highly available, fault tolerant, and optimized for low latency and high throughput.  Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve platform scalability, reliability, performance, and customer experience.  Work with Product Managers to define and implement new analytics capabilities and platform features.  Participate in Agile/Scrum ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog grooming, estimation, retrospectives, and release planning. Perform architecture discussions, design reviews, and peer code reviews while promoting software engineering best practices. We'd Love for You to Have:
 1–5+ years of professional experience in Java backend development and data engineering.  Strong computer science fundamentals including data structures, algorithms, distributed systems, and software design principles.  Hands-on experience developing scalable backend services using Java, REST APIs, JDBC, and relational databases.  Strong experience building distributed data pipelines using Spark, Kafka, Hadoop, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS.  Experience designing and optimizing large-scale analytical data platforms for Mobile AdTech using Java, Spark, Kafka, Snowflake, SQL, and AWS. * Decarbonization is the process to reduce or remove greenhouse gas emissions, especially carbon dioxide, from entering our atmosphere.

title: Senior Flutter Developer
description:
Job Description – Senior Flutter Developer

**Position:** Senior Flutter Developer  
**Location:** Malad, Mumbai  
**Employment Type:** Full\-Time  
**Experience:** 2–4 Years  
**Department:** Technology / Development  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced and technically strong **Senior Flutter Developer** to join our technology team in **Malad, Mumbai**.

The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on expertise in **Flutter and Dart**, with proven experience in architecting, developing, optimizing, and maintaining **high\-performing, scalable mobile applications** capable of handling high traffic, large datasets, and complex business requirements.

This role requires someone who goes beyond application development and takes ownership of **application architecture, performance, security, coding standards, version control, scalability, compliance awareness, automation, and continuous technical improvement**.

The candidate will work closely with internal development, UI/UX, backend, QA, product, and management teams to deliver robust and production\-ready applications for Android and iOS.

Key Responsibilities1\. Flutter \& Mobile Application Development

* Design, develop, and maintain high\-quality cross\-platform applications using **Flutter and Dart**.
* Build applications that are **scalable, secure, reliable, and optimized for high traffic and heavy data usage**.
* Develop reusable, modular, and maintainable components.
* Implement complex business logic while maintaining clean and efficient architecture.
* Work closely with backend developers for seamless API integration and data handling.
* Integrate third\-party APIs, SDKs, payment gateways, analytics, notifications, and other external services.
* Ensure applications perform consistently across different devices, screen sizes, and operating\-system versions.

2\. Application Architecture \& Scalability

* Design and implement **scalable mobile application architecture** suitable for large user bases and high\-volume transactions.
* Select appropriate architectural patterns and state\-management approaches based on project requirements.
* Design applications capable of efficiently handling **large datasets, high API traffic, concurrent users, and complex workflows**.
* Identify potential scalability and performance bottlenecks at the architecture and development stages.
* Ensure appropriate separation of presentation, business logic, data, and service layers.
* Develop reusable architecture and technical frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple applications.

3\. Performance \& High\-Traffic Applications

* Optimize applications for **speed, responsiveness, memory usage, battery consumption, and overall stability**.
* Work on applications handling **high traffic and large volumes of data**.
* Optimize API calls, database interactions, caching, pagination, lazy loading, background processing, and data rendering.
* Identify and resolve application crashes, ANRs, memory leaks, UI jank, slow screen rendering, and performance bottlenecks.
* Conduct profiling and performance analysis using appropriate Flutter and platform\-level tools.
* Ensure applications remain responsive and stable under heavy workloads.

4\. UI/UX \& Micro\-Interactions

* Convert UI/UX designs into highly polished, responsive, and production\-ready interfaces.
* Implement **micro\-animations, transitions, gestures, interactive elements, and smooth screen navigation** to enhance the user experience.
* Maintain consistency in typography, spacing, layouts, components, and design systems.
* Work closely with UI/UX designers to improve usability, accessibility, responsiveness, and overall application experience.
* Ensure animations are performance\-efficient and do not negatively impact application performance.

5\. Security \& Vulnerability Awareness

* Follow secure coding practices throughout the application development lifecycle.
* Identify and address **security vulnerabilities, insecure API usage, data exposure, authentication issues, and dependency risks**.
* Ensure sensitive information such as credentials, tokens, and user data is handled securely.
* Keep Flutter, Dart, third\-party packages, SDKs, and dependencies updated to address known security vulnerabilities.
* Participate in security reviews and remediation of vulnerabilities identified through internal or external security assessments.
* Maintain awareness of mobile application security standards and emerging security threats.

6\. Software Version Control \& Development Practices

* Maintain disciplined use of **Git and version\-control systems** such as GitHub/GitLab/Bitbucket.
* Follow proper branching, merging, pull\-request, tagging, release, and rollback strategies.
* Maintain clean and meaningful commit history.
* Conduct and participate in peer **code reviews**.
* Ensure code changes are properly documented and traceable.
* Establish and enforce development standards across projects and teams.

7\. Coding Standards \& Code Quality

* Write **clean, efficient, readable, maintainable, and reusable code**.
* Follow established Flutter/Dart coding standards and best practices.
* Establish and maintain coding guidelines, naming conventions, project structures, documentation standards, and review processes.
* Refactor legacy or inefficient code where required.
* Reduce technical debt and proactively identify areas requiring architectural or code\-level improvement.
* Mentor junior and mid\-level developers on coding practices, architecture, debugging, and performance optimization.

8\. Compliance, Upgrades \& Technology Awareness

* Work with internal technical teams to ensure applications remain aligned with required **platform, technology, security, and compliance standards**.
* Maintain awareness of changes and upgrade requirements related to:
* Flutter and Dart versions
* Android and iOS versions
* Google Play Store and Apple App Store requirements
* Third\-party SDKs and APIs
* Security vulnerabilities and patches
* Data and application\-security requirements
* Plan and execute technology upgrades without compromising application stability.
* Coordinate with internal teams for vulnerability remediation, compliance requirements, technology upgrades, and release readiness.
* Proactively assess the impact of technology changes before implementation.

9\. AI \& Automation

* Explore and implement **AI\-assisted development and automation tools** to improve development productivity and software quality.
* Identify opportunities to automate repetitive development, testing, documentation, monitoring, deployment, and support activities.
* Leverage AI tools responsibly for code generation, code review, debugging, testing, documentation, and development acceleration.
* Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their practical application within mobile application development.
* Contribute ideas for improving development workflows through automation.

10\. Testing, Release \& Production Support

* Develop applications with strong emphasis on quality and production stability.
* Write and maintain appropriate **unit, widget, integration, and automated tests**.
* Work closely with QA teams to resolve defects and improve application quality.
* Support application deployment and release processes for **Google Play Store and Apple App Store**.
* Monitor production issues and provide timely technical resolution.
* Participate in root\-cause analysis and implement preventive measures for recurring issues.
* Support production releases, hotfixes, version upgrades, and application maintenance.

Required Technical Skills

* **4–7 years of professional software development experience**, with strong hands\-on experience in Flutter.
* Advanced knowledge of **Flutter and Dart**.
* Strong understanding of mobile application architecture and design patterns.
* Experience building **large\-scale and high\-performance applications**.
* Experience handling **high traffic, large datasets, complex API integrations, and performance optimization**.
* Strong knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, HTTP/HTTPS and asynchronous programming.
* Strong experience with state management such as **Bloc, Riverpod, Provider, GetX**, or equivalent.
* Strong knowledge of **Git and software version\-control practices**.
* Experience with CI/CD and automated build and deployment processes.
* Strong understanding of debugging, profiling, memory management, and performance optimization.
* Experience with Firebase services such as Authentication, Cloud Messaging, Crashlytics, Analytics, Remote Config, etc.
* Experience integrating third\-party SDKs and APIs.
* Good understanding of application security and vulnerability management.
* Experience with automated testing and quality\-assurance practices.
* Familiarity with Android and iOS application lifecycle and release processes.

Preferred / Good\-to\-Have Skills

* Experience with native **Android/Kotlin** or **iOS/Swift** development.
* Experience with complex animations and advanced Flutter UI.
* Experience with payment gateway integration.
* Experience with real\-time applications, WebSockets, push notifications, or streaming data.
* Experience with offline\-first applications, local databases, caching, and synchronization.
* Knowledge of CI/CD tools and cloud\-based development environments.
* Experience with application monitoring and crash/performance analytics.
* Understanding of OWASP Mobile Application Security principles.
* Experience working on applications with millions of users or high transaction volumes.
* Exposure to AI\-powered development and automation tools.

Leadership \& Ownership

As a Senior Developer, the candidate will be expected to take **technical ownership** of assigned applications and modules.

Responsibilities will include:

* Independently analyse technical requirements and propose appropriate solutions.
* Take ownership of application architecture and technical implementation.
* Review code and provide constructive technical feedback to other developers.
* Mentor junior developers and help improve overall team capability.
* Identify technical risks and communicate them proactively.
* Participate in technical discussions, estimation, planning, and solution design.
* Take ownership of production issues and ensure timely resolution.
* Maintain technical documentation and architectural knowledge.
* Continuously evaluate opportunities to improve application performance, security, scalability, and maintainability.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for a candidate who demonstrates:

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Excellent understanding of software engineering principles.
* Strong ownership and accountability for deliverables.
* Ability to work independently on complex technical problems.
* Strong attention to application performance, security, and quality.
* Ability to think beyond immediate requirements and build solutions for future scalability.
* Good communication and collaboration skills.
* A continuous\-learning mindset with awareness of emerging technologies.
* Ability to mentor team members and contribute to improving engineering practices.

Education

* Bachelor's degree in **Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering**, or a related technical field is preferred.
* Equivalent practical experience and strong technical expertise will also be considered.

Key Success Areas

The successful candidate will be evaluated on their ability to:

**Build → Scale → Secure → Optimize → Automate → Maintain**

* Build robust Flutter applications.
* Design for scalability and high traffic.
* Maintain strong security and compliance awareness.
* Deliver excellent UI/UX and application performance.
* Follow high\-quality coding and version\-control standards.
* Reduce technical debt and improve existing applications.
* Introduce meaningful automation and AI\-assisted development practices.
* Take complete technical ownership of assigned applications.

What We Offer

* Exposure to modern technologies, AI\-assisted development, automation, security, and application optimization.
* Opportunity to work with experienced technology and product teams.
* Professional and collaborative work environment.
* Continuous learning and career\-growth opportunities.
* Opportunity to contribute to technical architecture and engineering standards.
* Full\-time position based at our **Malad, Mumbai office**.

Application Requirements

Interested candidates are requested to share their **updated CV** along with:

* Total years of experience
* Relevant Flutter experience

title: Workflow Engineer
description:
**About the Company** 




**Join the Rocketship 🚀** 




 We’re building
 **ShopOS** 
 —
 **AI agents powering the entire ecommerce stack.** 
 Already past PMF, we’re scaling fast and shaping the future of how online brands are built with AI. Co\-founded by seasoned builders with multiple successful exits to companies like
 **Flipkart** 
 and
 **Polygon Labs** 
 — and
 **backed by Binny Bansal** 
 — this isn’t just another start\-up. It’s your
 **front\-row seat to the next big shift in ecommerce.** 




  





**Watch** 
 :
 **What is ShopOS (from the founders’ lens \- Click here)** 




  





**About the Role** 




 As a Workflow Engineer at ShopOS, you'll be responsible for building the backbone of automation that powers our AI\-native commerce stack — and then owning it. That means designing and implementing modular, node\-based workflow systems that integrate across catalog management, creative tools, personalization engines, and fulfillment systems, but it also means being the person who fixes them when they break, upgrades them as we scale, and documents them well enough that anyone on the team can pick them up.
 



 This role is for engineers who enjoy solving complex logic puzzles, who think in flows and systems rather than one\-off deliverables, and who want to make things smarter, faster, and more reliable — not just build them once and move on. You'll work closely with product, AI, and design teams to turn business rules into reusable, low\-code/no\-code automations that deliver outsized leverage to our users.
 



  





**What You'll Own** 



* Build node\-based, rule\-driven workflows that support eCommerce operations and AI agent interactions
* Develop modular workflow components that can be composed into reusable, logic\-driven flows
* Integrate with APIs, data systems, and 3rd\-party services (Shopify, Stripe, Zapier, etc.)
* Diagnose and fix bugs in live workflows — including ones you didn't originally build
* Upgrade and refactor existing workflows for better reliability, speed, and cost
* Audit workflows on a regular cadence — flag fragile, redundant, or failure\-prone flows before they cause problems
* Maintain clear documentation for every workflow: what it does, what it depends on, what breaks it, how to fix it
* Set up admin interfaces and audit tools to monitor workflow health and performance
* Partner with product managers and designers to make workflows intuitive, testable, and transparent to end\-users
* Collaborate with AI/ML engineers to embed intelligence into decision points
* Own end\-to\-end delivery of key internal or external workflows (e.g. onboarding, content pipelines, personalization loops)
* Bring creative, non\-obvious solutions to recurring operational problems — not just the standard fix



**What We're Looking For** 



* CS background, with solid coding fundamentals
* Proficient in JavaScript and TypeScript
* Comfortable with Python for scripting and automation logic
* Hands\-on experience with node\-based / visual workflow builders (we currently run on Make; familiarity with n8n, Zapier, or similar counts too)
* Familiarity with Figma, Weavy, and ComfyUI
* Thinks in frameworks and systems rather than one\-off deliverables
* Strong debugging discipline — able to trace a failure across multiple connected systems, not just one node
* Comfortable with API integration (REST/GraphQL) and external services
* 2–4 years of experience — we're actively open to junior CS grads. Regardless of experience level, everyone gets trained on our systems, so raw fundamentals and problem\-solving instinct matter more than years on a resume



**Bonus Points** 



* Deep understanding of workflow engines, state machines, or rule engines
* Experience with event\-driven architectures and queueing systems (Kafka, RabbitMQ, SQS)
* Working knowledge of Postgres and Redis
* Comfortable with infra\-as\-code (Docker, Terraform), monitoring, and CI/CD
* Experience with other low\-code/no\-code or visual workflow tools (Temporal, Langchain, Camunda, Retool)
* Exposure to AI/LLM systems and how workflows interface with prompt generation, chaining, etc.
* Previous experience in commerce, logistics, or creative ops automation
* Built internal ops tools or dashboards from scratch in a fast\-moving startup
* Familiarity with configuration\-driven or metadata\-driven engineering



**You'll Thrive If You Are…** 



* A builder who thinks in flows, states, and transitions
* Obsessed with making systems smarter, faster, and self\-healing
* Pragmatic about complexity — knowing when to write code and when to wire blocks
* Solution\-first — you show up with fixes, not just problem reports
* A team player who enjoys working across product, design, and AI teams
* Excited by the idea of creating leverage and automation for every human in the loop

**Company Overview**
 Metayb is a digital transformation company on a mission to transform seamlessly by empowering organisations to navigate the vast landscape of the digital\-first era. Within just three years of inception, we have grown into a close\-knit family of 500\+ employees, each possessing rich field expertise. Metayb focuses on fostering seamless customer experiences, enhancing operational efficiency, and deriving actionable insights. By harnessing the power of emerging technologies, Metayb aims to be the unparalleled choice for global customers, delivering strategic goals effectively within a digital\-first ecosystem of value creation. Our key areas of expertise include Digital Transformation, Data Science, SAP Implementation, Workflow Automation, Dashboarding \& Visualization, Finance and Supply Chain Services. We strongly aspire to venture into IoT, AI/ML, and Virtual Reality.Metayb endeavours to be best\-in\-class across digital solutions, infrastructure, and product engineering.
   

  

**Key Attributes**
* Thorough knowledge of software development processes and life cycle, including conceiving, planning, execution, delivery, and scaling of large engineering projects.
* Ability to understand and communicate architectural principles, engineering best practices, coding standards, Agile methodologies, testing strategies, and team mentoring.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills; ability to engage with stakeholders, leadership, and facilitate client and internal meetings.
* Strong attention to detail, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, work efficiently, and meet tight deadlines.
* Strong desire to continuously learn and adapt to emerging technologies and industry trends.
* Strong problem\-solving mindset with the ability to drive execution with minimal supervision.
* Ability to drive engineering strategy through influence, with leadership qualities that engineers respect and follow.
* Ability to innovate and lead adoption of new technologies, tools, and engineering practices.
* Ability to establish, enforce, and evolve software engineering best practices, standards, and tools across teams.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\-functional teams including Product, Business, Design, and external partners.
* Strong ability to foster a culture of continuous improvement, innovation, and ownership across teams.
* Must be able to guide teams in building Proof of Concepts (POCs) and scalable solutions across full\-stack technologies.


**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead and manage engineering teams to design, develop, and deliver scalable, high\-quality software solutions aligned with business goals.
* Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to analyze business requirements and translate them into technical solutions and execution plans.
* Drive architecture discussions and ensure adoption of scalable, secure, and high\-performing system designs.
* Oversee development across modern architectures such as Microservices, Micro Frontend, Responsive Design, SPA, Composable, Serverless, Event\-Driven systems, and design patterns.
* Provide technical guidance on front\-end technologies such as React Js, Angular, Vue, Redux, React Native, TypeScript, JavaScript (ES5, ES6\), Webpack, SCSS, HTML5, CSS3\.
* Guide backend and platform development using Node.js, Express.js, MongoDB, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), Docker, and Kubernetes.
* Ensure best practices in mobile development using React Native, Flutter, Ionic, Swift/Objective\-C (iOS), and Java/Kotlin (Android).
* Oversee development of large\-scale, high\-performance user interfaces using modern UI frameworks and libraries.
* Drive enterprise integration strategies using middleware technologies, REST/SOAP services, databases, ETL, and ESB patterns.
* Provide leadership in core backend technologies such as Java, J2EE (JSP, Servlet, JDBC, JMS), Spring Framework, REST APIs, and related technologies (Python as an alternative).
* Ensure delivery of highly scalable, reliable systems through effective system design and architecture.
* Build, mentor, and scale high\-performing engineering teams with strong ownership and accountability.
* Drive best practices in DevOps, CI/CD pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).
* Oversee cloud infrastructure design, implementation, and optimization across AWS, GCP, or Azure.
* Collaborate with leadership to define engineering roadmaps, resource planning, and delivery timelines.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree (BE, BTech) in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience in engineering management with a strong technical background in full\-stack development.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
* Strong mentoring and leadership skills with the ability to build and scale engineering teams.


**Disclaimer**
 The job title mentioned in this description is generic and intended for broad categorization purposes. The final designation will be determined based on the candidate’s performance during the interview process, relevant experience, and alignment with the organizational hierarchy.

title: UI Lead (C++, WIN32 HMI)
description:
**JOB TITLE** 
 :
 
 UI Lead (QT \\ C\+\+ WIN32\)
 




  




* Location: Hyderabad (On\-site)
* Experience:
 **5–8 years (Lead Developer)** 
 \&\&
* Experience:
 **1–4 years (Developer)**



  




* Notice Period: Immediate to 15 days
* Domain: Aerospace \& Defense (Preferred) OR Advanced Automotive / High\-Performance Simulation



  





**ABOUT THE ROLE** 




  





 We are looking for a C\+\+ QT WIN32 UI Developer \\Lead
 



  





 Developer to drive the design and implementation of our next\-generation Mission Planning Software. This role focuses on building high\-performance, low\-latency tactical control dashboards where visual clarity, real\-time responsiveness, and absolute stability are critical.
 



 In this role, you will bridge the gap between user experience architecture and heavy\-duty desktop systems engineering, transforming complex telemetry, 3D spatial data, and GIS mapping into intuitive, robust Windows desktop applications.
 



  





**WHAT YOU WILL DO** 



* Lead UI Architecture: Own the end\-to\-end user interface architecture of proprietary Mission Planning Systems using C\+\+, WIN32 and the Qt framework.
* Optimize Performance: Tune and maintain native Windows application performance, tightly managing memory footprint, rendering cycles, and CPU/GPU utilization.
* Implement Complex Workflows: Translate highly technical operational workflows, GIS mapping elements, and real\-time data streams into slick, fluid UI layouts.
* Mentor \& Standardize: Guide mid\-level engineers, establishing clean code practices, robust code reviews, and efficient UI state management.



  





**THE MUST\-HAVE SKILL SET** 



* Core Stack: Expert\-level proficiency in Modern C\+\+ (C\+\+11/14/17\) and deep, hands\-on experience with the Qt framework (Widgets and/or QML).
* Windows Desktop Internals: Strong expertise in building native apps optimized for the Windows Platform, including familiarity with Win32 API for low\-level OS interaction.
* High\-Performance Rendering: Practical experience with Dear ImGui (ImGui) or custom graphics rendering pipeline integration (OpenGL/DirectX) for lightweight, low\-latency data visualization.
* Domain Background: Experience working on Mission Planning Software, Ground Control Stations (GCS), GIS/mapping applications, or safety\-critical dashboards.



  





*Note: Candidates from the Automotive/Gaming sectors who have built complex ADAS simulation, infotainment systems, or real\-time telemetry tools are highly encouraged to apply.* 




  





**HOW TO APPLY** 




 If you thrive on writing high\-performance desktop software where every millisecond counts, we want to hear from you.
 



  





 Please send your updated resume directly to
 **communications@qubistsolutions.com**

title: Director of Engineering Consumer Experience - Web & Mobile
description:
SPEED \& SPIRIT is what we look for in our candidates, defined by some simple values that inspire us to BE DRIVEN in our performance, BE VIBRANT in our sporting legacy, BE TOGETHER in our team spirit, and BE YOU to let our individual talent and experience shine. Applying for a job at PUMA is easy and all genders are welcome. Simply click APPLY ONLINE and follow the steps to upload your application.
   

  

**YOUR MISSION:**
 As Director of Engineering \- Consumer Experience, you'll lead the technology organisation responsible for delivering exceptional digital experiences across Web and Mobile platforms. This is a horizontal, platform\-level leadership role that sets the engineering direction, standards, and quality bar across every consumer\-facing product in our Direct\-to\-Consumer (DTC) business.
   

  

 You'll own the engineering foundation that product teams build upon \- shared platform capabilities, AI\-native tooling, frontend standards, and delivery infrastructure \- and lead a lean team of senior engineers and a network of delivery partners to build fast, accessible, AI\-native experiences that delight our consumers. You'll hold platform adoption authority and co\-own the engineering quality bar across the organisation.
   

  

 As PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organization, our leaders are expected to be visible culture builders. These roles are office\-based and require regular in\-person collaboration to accelerate decision\-making, strengthen team cohesion, foster innovation, and build a world\-class engineering capability from the ground up.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities \& Scope of Ownership:**
**Technology Vision \& Strategy**
* Define and drive the multi\-year Consumer Experience technology vision, ensuring alignment with DTC business goals and emerging digital trends.
* Build and communicate a clear technology roadmap covering Web (desktop, PWA) and Native Mobile (iOS, Android) platforms.
* Champion AI\-native engineering paradigm \- from AI\-assisted development workflows to front\-end personalisation and intelligent UX embedded into the engineering culture from day one.
* Evaluate, select, and govern the technology stack (ReactJS, GraphQL, and emerging tools) to ensure longevity, performance, and developer productivity.


**Standards, Governance \& Engineering Excellence**
* Establish and enforce engineering standards, coding practices, design systems, accessibility guidelines (WCAG), and performance benchmarks across all consumer\-facing touchpoints.
* Build and own a component library and design system that enables velocity and consistency for all product teams.
* Define governance frameworks for third\-party vendor engagement including contracts, code quality reviews, delivery cadence, and SLA management.
* Introduce and maintain observability, performance monitoring, and incident management practices for consumer\-facing platforms.


**UI/UX \& Consumer Experience Leadership**
* Partner closely with UX/Design, Product, and Marketing teams to translate consumer insights into technically excellent digital experiences.
* Own the front\-end architecture for responsive, performant, and accessible web experiences and mobile applications.
* Drive adoption of modern UX engineering practices such as skeleton screens, optimistic UI, progressive enhancement, micro\-interactions.
* Champion performance engineering \- page load, rendering optimisation, image delivery, CDN strategy, and headless CMS integration via Sanity.


**Team \& Vendor Leadership**
* Lead, mentor, and grow a lean team of senior engineers while maintaining a high\-trust, high\-performance culture.
* Manage and hold accountable delivery partners for quality, timelines, and engineering standards.
* Partner with Engineering Heads, Product Owners and peer Directors to ensure horizontal services (design systems, shared APIs, performance tooling) are adopted consistently.


**YOUR TALENT:**
**Key Requirements:**
* 15\+ years of progressive engineering experience, with 5\+ years in a senior engineering leadership role.
* Strong architectural and implementation experience in modern front\-end engineering: ReactJS, TypeScript, GraphQL (GQL), REST APIs.
* Demonstrable mobile architecture \& engineering experience across React Native or iOS (Swift)/Android (Kotlin).
* Track record of building and governing cross\-functional engineering platforms used by multiple product teams.
* Strong working knowledge of modern consumer web standards, specifically web performance (Core Web Vitals), WCAG 2\.1 compliance, and progressive web applications.
* Background in fashion, retail, or sports DTC commerce environments.
* Experience with composable/headless commerce architectures.
* Experience with CI/CD, feature flagging, A/B testing frameworks.
* Experience with Design Systems \& Shared UI Platforms is highly preferred.
* Experience in SFCC (Salesforce Commerce Cloud) storefront or equivalent will be a plus.
* Demonstrated adoption of AI\-assisted engineering practices across the software development lifecycle to improve engineering productivity, software quality and efficiency.


**Leadership Expectations:**
* At PUMA, Directors are expected to operate as enterprise leaders who shape strategy, build capability, and create an environment where teams can deliver exceptional outcomes at speed and scale. Successful leaders combine commercial acumen, technical excellence, and people leadership while embodying the mindset and behaviours that define PUMA's culture.


**Strategic Thinking \& Vision**
* Translate ambitious business goals into clear, executable technology strategies and roadmaps.
* Demonstrate the courage to challenge conventional thinking and advocate for innovative solutions that create long\-term value.
* Operate effectively in ambiguity, providing clarity, direction, and confidence for teams and stakeholders.
* Balance immediate business priorities with long\-term scalability, sustainability, and consumer impact.
* Ownership \& Accountability
* Take end\-to\-end ownership of outcomes, driving execution with determination and a strong focus on results.
* Set high standards for quality, reliability, and operational excellence while fostering a culture of accountability.
* Navigate setbacks and changing priorities with resilience, maintaining momentum through complexity and uncertainty.
* Make difficult decisions when required and stand behind them with conviction and integrity.


**People \& Team Leadership**
* Build, develop, and retain diverse, high\-performing teams capable of delivering at scale.
* Foster an environment of trust, inclusion, collaboration, and mutual respect where individuals can thrive.
* Create opportunities for learning, growth, and continuous development while empowering teams with autonomy and accountability.
* Celebrate successes, recognise contributions, and cultivate a culture where high performance and enjoyment go hand in hand.


**Collaboration \& Stakeholder Management**
* Build strong partnerships across Product, Design, Data, Marketing, Operations, and Business teams to achieve shared outcomes.
* Influence effectively across all levels of the organisation through credibility, transparency, and strong communication.
* Demonstrate confidence in decision\-making while remaining open to challenge, feedback, and diverse perspectives.
* Lead with a team\-first mindset, breaking down silos and enabling collaboration across functions and geographies.


**Innovation \& Continuous Learning**
* Champion modern engineering practices, AI\-native ways of working, and a culture of experimentation.
* Encourage curiosity, learning, and thoughtful risk\-taking to unlock new opportunities for consumers and the business.
* Create space for innovation while maintaining a disciplined approach to execution and delivery.
* Continuously raise the bar on engineering excellence, operational maturity, and consumer experience.


**Commercial \& Consumer Mindset**
* Understand the connection between technology decisions, consumer experience, and business performance.
* Make decisions that balance innovation, speed, quality, and commercial impact.
* Maintain a strong consumer\-first perspective, ensuring technology investments create meaningful value for consumers.
* Demonstrate sound judgment and confidence when translating business priorities into engineering outcomes.


**Building PUMA's Future**
* Act as a visible culture builder and role model as PUMA continues to scale its DTC Engineering organisation.
* Embrace the opportunity to build teams, capabilities, and ways of working from the ground up.
* Lead with energy, optimism, and purpose, inspiring others to contribute to a shared vision and ambitious goals.
* Foster an environment where bold thinking, determination, collaboration, and enjoyment are all essential ingredients of success.


 PUMA provides equal opportunities for all job applicants, regardless of race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, or disability. Equality for all is one of the core principles at PUMA and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.
   

  

 At PUMA, every application is reviewed by real people who are committed to fairness, transparency, and equal opportunity \- no matter your background, identity, or experience. To ensure our process stays true to these values, no automated systems or AI tools are used to make hiring decisions. Every decision is made by real people \-with real judgment and accountability. We may use functions supported by Artificial Intelligence (AI) to carry out isolated organizational steps, such as scheduling interviews. These functions have no influence on decisions in the application process. We believe in creating spaces where everyone is welcome, celebrated, and empowered to contribute authentically. Because at PUMA, whoever wants to play, can play.
   

  

 PUMA is a global sports brand creating footwear, apparel, and accessories that inspire athletes and everyday movers. The PUMA Group owns PUMA, Cobra Golf, and stichd, operates in 120\+ countries, and has around 22,000 employees worldwide.

title: Technical Team Lead – IT Software Development
description:
**Company:** Quickensol IT Solutions LLP  
**Location:** Viman Nagar, Pune  
**Experience:** 4\+ years in software development, including team\-handling experience  
**Salary:** ₹45,000 – ₹60,000 per month  
**Position:** 1

**About the Role**

Quickensol IT Solutions LLP is looking for an experienced **Technical Team Lead** who can take ownership of technical delivery, guide developers, review code, prepare technical estimates, resolve technical blockers, and ensure projects are delivered on time with good code quality.

This role is suitable for a strong developer who is ready to move beyond individual coding and take responsibility for the **overall technical performance of the development team**.

**Key Responsibilities**

Lead and manage the technical development team.  
Understand project requirements and convert them into technical tasks.  
Analyse requirements before development starts.  
Estimate development effort and timelines.  
Allocate technical tasks to PHP, React/App and other developers.  
Monitor developer productivity and task completion.  
Review code and ensure coding standards are followed.  
Identify technical blockers and resolve them quickly.  
Guide junior and mid\-level developers.  
Review database structure, APIs, application flow and technical implementation.  
Ensure proper development, testing and deployment processes are followed.  
Coordinate with project coordinators for project timelines and priorities.  
Support the project coordinator in providing realistic technical timelines to clients.  
Ensure developers do not make unrealistic commitments to clients.  
Conduct technical discussions and code reviews.  
Identify repeated technical mistakes and implement corrective processes.  
Handle critical bugs and production issues.  
Maintain technical documentation wherever required.  
Ensure projects follow the company’s development standards and architecture.  
Help improve development processes, productivity, and code quality.

**Team Management**

The Team Lead will be responsible for the technical performance of the development team, including:

4 PHP Developers  
2 App/React Developers  
Coordination with 2 QA Testers

The Team Lead should know **who is working on what, expected completion time, current blockers, QA status and pending technical issues** at all times.

**Required Technical Skills**

Strong hands\-on experience in one or more of the following:

PHP  
CodeIgniter / Laravel  
MySQL / MariaDB  
REST APIs  
JavaScript / jQuery  
React.js  
Mobile application development understanding  
Git  
API integration  
Database design  
Debugging and performance optimisation

Candidates with strong **PHP \+ CodeIgniter \+ MySQL** experience will be preferred.

**Required Leadership Skills**

Strong problem\-solving ability.  
Good communication skills.  
Ability to manage developers and technical priorities.  
Ability to estimate development work realistically.  
Ability to identify whether a task is blocked because of requirement, technical complexity, dependency or developer performance.  
Strong ownership and accountability.  
Ability to mentor junior developers.  
Ability to handle pressure and multiple projects.  
Good coordination with Project Coordinators and QA team.

**Important Requirement**

This is **not a Senior Developer position with only a different designation**.

The candidate must be capable of taking responsibility for:

**Technical Planning → Task Allocation → Development → Code Review → QA Coordination → Bug Resolution → Technical Delivery**

A candidate who prefers only individual coding and does not want team responsibility will not be suitable for this position.

**Preferred Experience**

Candidates who have worked in:

ERP software companies  
SaaS companies  
Web application development  
Mobile application projects  
Multi\-project development environments  
Client\-based software development companies

will be preferred.

**Performance Expectations**

The selected Team Lead will be expected to maintain:

90%\+ planned task delivery  
100% code review for applicable development tasks  
Proper task estimation  
Timely technical blocker resolution  
Reduced repeated bugs  
Proper developer task allocation  
Clear coordination with Project Coordinators  
Improved overall team productivity

title: Lead Mobile SDET
description:
At OneSpan, we specialize in digital identity and anti\-fraud solutions that create exceptional and secure experiences.
   

  

 At OneSpan we are looking for a
 **Lead SDET (Software Development Engineer in Test)** 
 — a strong software engineer who specializes in test — to architect and own our QA automation frameworks and strategy across the entire Mobile Security Suite (MSS) SDK portfolio. Our Mobile Security Suite (MSS) spans multiple SDKs across iOS, Android, and server\-side platforms (.NET and Java).
   

  

 This is a hybrid role: part hands\-on automation engineer, part technical lead. You will work alongside our Android automation developer, manual QA engineer, and feature developers, contribute directly to test automation across all MSS SDKs, and design the frameworks, tooling, strategy, and roadmap that take our QA practice to the next level.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead Test Strategy: Assess current automation coverage across all MSS SDKs (iOS, Android, server\-side), identify gaps, and define the testing strategy, tooling, and project setup needed to close them.
* Contribute Hands\-On: Design, write, and maintain automated tests across iOS, Android, and server\-side SDKs — using AI coding tools and partnering with feature developers on platforms where you need extra language or domain support.
* Own the Pipelines: Build and maintain GitLab CI pipelines (YAML), Bash scripts, and Gradle builds across our multiple SDK pipelines to run automated suites, stand up local/test servers, and integrate with real\-device testing cloud solutions.
* Drive Planning \& Reporting: Prepare quality and coverage reports, and bring recommendations and next steps to quarterly planning with engineering leadership.
* Mentor the Team: Guide the automation developers, feature developers, and QA engineers who contribute to automation; help formalize processes, code review standards, and best practices.
* Keep Growing: Stay current with mobile and server\-side testing tools and frameworks; proactively identify and fill missing skills or tooling gaps on the team.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Automation Leadership: 6\+ years in software test automation, including experience defining test strategy and leading or mentoring other engineers.
* Framework Architecture: Proven track record designing, building, and maintaining test automation frameworks and harnesses from the ground up — abstraction layers, reusable components, test data and fixtures — not just writing tests against an existing suite.
* Mobile Automation Expertise: Deep hands\-on mobile test automation in at least one mobile stack — iOS (Swift, XCTest/XCUITest) or Android (Kotlin, Compose Test/Espresso/UI Automator) — with the ability to extend to the other and to server\-side, using AI coding tools and feature\-developer support to bridge gaps.
* Test Infrastructure: Builds and owns the test infrastructure that runs the suites, including integration with the third\-party real\-device cloud services we use for tests that need real hardware.
* CI/CD \& Scripting: GitLab CI and YAML pipeline authoring, Bash scripting, Gradle.
* Version Control: Git and standard branching / pull request workflows.
* Comfortable working across a multi\-language, multi\-platform codebase and picking up a new language or framework when a project requires it.


**Nice to Have**
* Server\-Side: Java, Spring or Spring Boot, JUnit 4 and JUnit 5\.
* .NET / C\# experience, to extend automation coverage to .NET\-based server components.
* Experience testing security\-sensitive SDKs (e.g., anti\-tampering, threat detection, RASP) or working in a regulated / security\-conscious product environment.
* Prior experience leading or building a QA automation function from an early stage.


**Soft Skills**
* Strong leadership and mentoring instincts, with the ability to influence without formal authority.
* Clear communicator, comfortable presenting test strategy, status, and risks to management.
* Analytical and gap\-driven — able to look at a large, multi\-platform codebase and identify where quality risk actually lives.
* Eager to learn and self\-directed in closing skill or tooling gaps.
