title: Senior QA Engineer — Web & Mobile
description:
Role Overview : We are looking for a  Senior QA Automation Engineer  with a minimum of 7 years of software testing experience, including strong hands-on automation across web (Playwright) and mobile (Appium) platforms. The ideal candidate owns automation frameworks end to end, brings a strong testing-fundamentals background, and can independently drive quality strategy across product releases while mentoring the wider QA team. Key Responsibilities : Test Planning & Design Understand project requirements and develop detailed test plans, test cases, test scenarios, and the corresponding automation strategy. Participate in requirement analysis, design discussions, and review meetings to provide input on testability, risk, and automation feasibility. Decide what belongs in automation vs. manual/exploratory testing and define the regression scope for each release. Automation Framework Ownership Design, build, and maintain scalable automation frameworks using Playwright (TypeScript/JavaScript) for web and Appium for Android/iOS. Establish and enforce framework conventions — page/domain helpers, fixtures, test data builders, reusable utilities — so the suite stays maintainable as it grows. Integrate automated suites into CI/CD pipelines (Jenkins / Bitbucket Pipelines / GitHub Actions) with scheduled runs, parallel execution, and actionable reporting. Own suite health: investigate and eliminate flaky tests, reduce execution time, and keep pass-rate signal trustworthy. Execute and maintain runs on real devices and cross-browser grids (e.g. BrowserStack / Sauce Labs / device farms). Test Execution Perform functional, integration, system, regression, and API testing on web and mobile applications. Execute both manual and automated test cases; convert high-value repeatable manual cases into automated coverage. Validate backend behaviour through API testing (REST) and SQL database checks. Defect Management Work closely with developers to reproduce, analyze, and resolve issues; drive them to closure. Distinguish genuine product defects from test/environment issues before raising them never mask a real bug by adjusting a test. Maintain clear, reproducible documentation of bugs, test results, and root-cause findings. Reporting & Communication Prepare test reports summarizing test activities, automation coverage, outcomes, and quality metrics. Communicate test progress, release readiness, risks, and results to stakeholders and leadership. Publish periodic quality dashboards (coverage, defect trends, automation pass rate, execution time). Collaboration & Mentoring Collaborate with cross-functional teams including developers, product managers, and business analysts to ensure software quality. Review automation code written by other QA engineers and enforce coding and design standards. Mentor junior and mid-level QA engineers on automation practices, debugging techniques, and testing fundamentals. Required Skills Automation 4+ years of hands-on automation experience, with strong command of Playwright for web UI automation. Hands-on experience with Appium for native/hybrid mobile app automation on Android and iOS. Proficiency in TypeScript / JavaScript (or strong equivalent OOP language experience with willingness to work in TypeScript). Has built an automation framework from the ground up, not only added scripts to one that already existed. Experience with API test automation and response/schema validation. Working knowledge of Git and branching workflows; comfortable raising and reviewing pull requests. Testing Techniques Expert in test case design, test execution, and defect reporting. Strong understanding of the software development life cycle (SDLC) and software testing life cycle (STLC). Solid grasp of test design techniques — boundary value analysis, equivalence partitioning, decision tables, risk-based testing. Tools & Technologies Bug tracking tools such as JIRA, Bugzilla, or similar. Test management tools such as TestRail, Zephyr, BrowserStack Test Management, or similar. CI/CD tooling — Jenkins, Bitbucket Pipelines, GitHub Actions, or similar. Cloud device/browser labs such as BrowserStack or Sauce Labs. Domain Knowledge Proven experience testing both web and mobile applications. Good working knowledge of SQL for database testing and data validation. Familiarity with performance or security testing basics is an added advantage. Good to Have Experience introducing contract testing, service virtualisation, or API mocking to de-risk dependent services. Performance testing experience with JMeter, k6, or Gatling, and the ability to interpret results. Security testing basics — OWASP Top 10 awareness, and use of tools such as OWASP ZAP or Burp Suite. Experience with visual regression and accessibility automation (Percy, axe-core, Lighthouse). Docker/Kubernetes familiarity for containerised test execution. Experience defining and tracking quality KPIs — escaped-defect rate, automation ROI, mean time to triage. Test data management strategy at scale — seeding, masking, and environment isolation. Experience defining a shift-left or in-sprint automation model and getting a team to adopt it. Exposure to observability tooling (Grafana, Datadog, Sentry) for correlating test failures with system behaviour. Experience applying AI-assisted tooling to test generation, failure triage, or code review, with judgement about where it should not be trusted. Soft Skills Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills; able to root-cause an issue rather than report only the symptom. Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality results. Good communication and interpersonal skills; able to present quality status confidently to stakeholders. Ownership mindset — takes responsibility for release quality end to end. Collaboration and communication : Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre. How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals : Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the technology function with overall business goals.

**About the role and team**  

  

Engineering at Uber means building for real\-world impact under real\-world constraints. As a **Senior Staff Software Engineer in Rider** , you will shape the technical architecture and long\-term evolution of the systems that power the Rider experience globally.
  

  

Deep mobile architecture expertise will be the anchor for this role, but not its boundary. You will operate across mobile clients, edge capabilities, and backend services, tackling problems spanning application architecture, performance, reliability, server\-driven experiences, client\-server contracts, and emerging on\-device intelligence.
  

  

Your impact will extend well beyond the code you write. You will shape how multiple engineering teams build and ship Rider experiences\-establishing durable technical foundations, simplifying complex systems, making high\-leverage architectural decisions, and enabling teams to move faster without compromising performance, reliability, or quality.
  

  

**What you'll do*** Define the multi\-year technical strategy and architecture for Rider experiences across mobile applications, client platforms, edge capabilities, and supporting backend services.
* Set the architectural direction for the Rider application and client platform, enabling multiple teams to independently build and evolve experiences without compromising performance, reliability, or consistency.
* Establish engineering standards and technical foundations across architecture, dependency management, build health, application size, startup and runtime performance, observability, testing, and release quality.
* Architect server\-driven and cross\-platform experience frameworks, making deliberate trade\-offs between native, web\-based, shared, and backend\-driven implementations.
* Define durable client\-server contracts covering API design, schema evolution, backward compatibility, rollout safety, experimentation, offline behavior, and failure recovery.
* Shape the architecture for emerging on\-device and edge capabilities, determining what should run on the client versus backend systems while balancing latency, privacy, reliability, battery consumption, and cost.
* Build frameworks, SDKs, developer tools, and reusable abstractions that make it easier for product teams to deliver high\-quality Rider experiences without repeatedly solving underlying platform problems.
* Work with Product and Engineering leadership to identify architectural constraints and technical bets that materially expand the set of Rider experiences we can build, and shape investment priorities accordingly.
* Lead major architectural migrations and reduce systemic technical debt, improving engineering velocity, reliability, performance, and product quality across the organization.
* Navigate ambiguous, cross\-organizational technical problems where there is no obvious architectural answer; make clear trade\-offs, establish alignment, and drive decisions to durable outcomes.
* Stay close to the technology and periodically dive deep into the hardest architectural and technical problems, while multiplying impact through Staff\+ engineers and technical leaders across the organization.

**What you'll need*** Extensive experience building and operating large\-scale production applications on Android or iOS, with deep expertise in mobile architecture.
* Proven experience driving major mobile\-architecture decisions across areas such as modularization, application performance, build systems, dependency management, application size, or release infrastructure.
* Demonstrated ability to reason and operate across the client\-server boundary, including designing APIs, data contracts, rollout mechanisms, and resilient end\-to\-end experiences.
* Track record of building platforms, frameworks, or engineering standards adopted by multiple teams\-not solely delivering individual product features.
* Experience establishing multi\-year technical direction and anticipating architectural risks before they constrain product or organizational execution.
* Demonstrated success leading complex, cross\-functional engineering initiatives from strategy and design through global production adoption.
* Proven ability to influence across organizational boundaries and align senior engineering, product, and business stakeholders around a technical direction.
* Expertise in establishing standards and practices for testing, performance, observability, reliability, and incident management.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with large monorepositories, build systems such as Bazel, and mobile developer\-productivity infrastructure.
* Experience optimizing applications for constrained devices and networks, particularly in emerging markets.
* Experience with on\-device machine learning, model deployment and optimization, mobile ML runtimes, or hardware\-accelerated inference.
* Experience building mobile experiences powered by LLMs or agents, including architectures that distribute intelligence across device and backend systems.

Experience representing an organization through internal technical forums, external publications, conference talks, or open\-source contributions.

title: Principal / Senior Software Engineer - Mobile Monetization (Ad Server)
description:
**About The Role**
 PubMatic is seeking an experienced and technically strong Principal Software Engineer to lead the design and development of next\-generation Mobile App Monetization capabilities. This role is focused on building high\-performance, low\-latency, scalable, and privacy\-safe systems that help maximize publisher revenue from in\-app inventory while improving DSP and buyer spend efficiency.
   

  

 The role requires a deep understanding of mobile app advertising, SSP\-DSP RTB workflows, OpenRTB mobile signals, SDK/mediation integrations, traffic shaping, QPS optimization, mobile attribution, privacy constraints, and performance advertising. The engineer will work on systems that monetize mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is a seasoned backend engineer with strong ad\-tech domain expertise and experience building real\-time auction, targeting, decisioning, and optimization systems. You will work closely with Product, Data Science, Marketplace Quality, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, and SRE to build ML\-integrated and data\-driven monetization systems that improve yield, bid rate, win rate, fill rate, attribution readiness, latency, and reliability across PubMatic’s mobile app ecosystem.
   

  

**What You'll Do**
* Architect and implement scalable backend services powering mobile app monetization, extracting, transforming, and optimizing in\-app behavioral data using on\-device computation, data aggregation, and differential privacy techniques so that publishers can still deliver targeted ads and measure performance without accessing persistent, individual user identities.
* Build and optimize SSP\-DSP integration workflows for mobile app inventory, including app bundle validation, device and geo signal handling, privacy\-aware user signal processing, bid response handling, loss reason analysis, and DSP\-specific troubleshooting.
* Design mobile\-specific traffic shaping and QPS optimization systems that prioritize high\-value in\-app inventory based on bid probability, win probability, spend potential, app quality, device signals, geo value, ad format, consent availability, and DSP buying behavior.
* Improve runtime handling for Mobile App ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video, including format eligibility, creative compatibility, response validation, tracking, completion, and reward\-callback correctness.
* Build capabilities that improve buyer/DSP compatibility for MApp inventory, ensuring buyers receive well\-represented, privacy\-compliant, format\-compatible, attribution\-ready, and supply\-quality\-aware mobile app requests.
* Develop systems and diagnostics to improve Mobile App supply quality, including app bundle validation, app store metadata checks, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, SupplyChain object validation, app spoofing detection, invalid traffic indicators, device/geo inconsistency checks, and low\-quality partner supply detection.
* Support privacy\-aware and attribution\-ready Mobile App advertising, including ATT/IDFA handling, AAID availability, consent enforcement, COPPA/child\-directed treatment, SKAN readiness, MMP signal passing, click/impression tracking, and privacy\-safe fallback when user\-level identifiers are unavailable.
* Partner with MApp SDK and OpenBid/S2S integration teams to define signal\-quality standards, request\-field expectations, placement/ad\-unit semantics, tracking requirements, and partner feedback loops for Mobile App supply.
* Build publisher\-facing and buyer\-facing diagnostics for MApp inventory, including missing\-field reports, app quality signals, buyer no\-bid diagnostics, fill and eCPM diagnostics, tracking mismatch analysis, attribution readiness, and supply\-path quality insights.
* Work with DSP Partnerships and Marketplace Quality teams to improve buyer confidence in PubMatic’s MApp supply by addressing format compatibility, attribution readiness, privacy eligibility, fraud risk, supply transparency, and app inventory quality.
* Collaborate with Product, Data Science, Publisher teams, DSP Partnerships, Marketplace Quality, MApp SDK, OpenBid/S2S integrations, and SRE to define and execute the roadmap for differentiated Mobile App advertising capabilities.
* Champion operational excellence for Mobile App advertising systems through strong observability, reason codes, structured logs, dashboards, alerts, safe rollouts, latency protection, production debugging, and cross\-team incident response.


**We'd Love for You to Have**
* Five plus years of backend engineering experience, with a proven track record of building high\-scale, low\-latency systems, preferably in mobile app advertising, SSP, DSP, ad exchange, mediation, mobile SDK, app\-install, or programmatic AdTech domains.
* Strong knowledge of mobile app inventory signals, including app bundle, app store URL, SDK version, placement type, rewarded indicator, device ID, IDFA, AAID, IDFV, OS version, carrier, connection type, geo, consent status, and ad format metadata.
* Familiarity with mobile ad formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and in\-app video ads, including how each format impacts pricing, buyer demand, creative rendering, tracking, and user experience.
* Strong understanding of mobile performance advertising concepts such as app\-install campaigns, CPI, CPA, ROAS, retention, lifetime value, post\-install events, retargeting where allowed, and buyer outcome optimization.
* Experience or strong familiarity with mobile attribution and measurement ecosystems, including MMPs, AppsFlyer, Adjust, Singular, Firebase, SKAdNetwork, Android attribution changes, click tracking, impression tracking, and delayed/aggregated conversion signals.
* Strong knowledge of mobile privacy and compliance constraints, including Apple ATT, IDFA availability, Android Advertising ID, SKAdNetwork, Google Privacy Sandbox for Android, COPPA, GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, TCF, GPP, and do\-not\-sell/share flags.
* Practical knowledge of mobile supply quality and fraud prevention, including app bundle spoofing, SDK spoofing, device spoofing, geo mismatch, VPN/proxy traffic, click injection, click spam, invalid traffic, app\-ads.txt, sellers.json, and SupplyChain object validation.
* Excellent interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with a collaborative mindset, strong ownership, and ability to work cross\-functionally with Product, Data Science, DSP Partnerships, Publisher teams, Marketplace Quality, and SRE.


**Bonus Qualifications**
* Hands\-on experience with mobile monetization SDKs, client\-server ad request flows, mediation logic, in\-app bidding, server\-side bidding, waterfalls, or unified auction systems.
* Contributions to open\-source AdTech projects such as Prebid Mobile, RTBkit, OpenRTB tools, header bidding libraries, or mobile SDK/ad\-serving frameworks.
* Familiarity with industry\-standard ML model\-serving infrastructure designed for real\-time inference in high\-QPS, low\-latency environments.
* Understanding of mobile user acquisition, performance DSPs, app\-install campaigns, MMP integrations, and attribution platforms.
* Experience working with incrementality measurement, retargeting systems, audience segmentation, cohort\-based optimization, or privacy\-safe targeting for mobile performance marketing.
* Exposure to privacy\-preserving user ID solutions such as UID2\.0, RampID, publisher first\-party IDs, hashed identifiers where allowed, and frameworks such as SKAdNetwork for iOS post\-ATT monetization.
* Experience with cross\-format mobile monetization strategies, including combining rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video monetization within the same app session.
* Familiarity with real\-time analytics pipelines used to measure mobile monetization KPIs such as bid rate, win rate, fill rate, eCPM, revenue, QPS efficiency, timeout rate, attribution feedback, buyer spend, and yield efficiency.
* Publications, patents, internal platform leadership, or speaking engagements in mobile monetization, AdTech infrastructure, RTB optimization, privacy\-safe advertising, or ML for AdTech.


**Why Join Us?**
* Work on high\-scale mobile monetization infrastructure that directly impacts publisher revenue, DSP spend, and advertiser outcomes across the in\-app advertising ecosystem.
* Help shape the future of ML\-powered mobile monetization, real\-time ad decisioning, traffic shaping, attribution readiness, and privacy\-safe performance advertising.
* Build systems that improve monetization across premium mobile formats such as rewarded video, interstitial, native, banner, app\-open, playable, and video ads.
* Collaborate with industry\-leading engineers, product teams, machine learning experts, DSP partners, publisher teams, and marketplace quality teams.
* Competitive compensation, performance\-based incentives, and strong career growth opportunities in a globally recognized AdTech company.


**AI\-Enabled Engineering Mindset**
 We value engineers who actively leverage Generative AI tools and IDEs (e.g. GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, Windsurf etc.) to accelerate development, improve code quality, automate repetitive tasks, and enhance documentation and debugging workflows. Engineers who demonstrate AI\-first thinking using these tools to drive faster experimentation, ideation, and technical execution will thrive in our high\-scale, performance\-critical environment.
   

  

**Qualifications**
* Should have a bachelor’s degree in engineering (CS / IT) or equivalent degree from well\-known Institutes / Universities.


**Additional Information**
**Return to Office** 
 : PubMatic employees throughout the global have returned to our offices via a hybrid work schedule (3 days “in office” and 2 days “working remotely”) that is intended to maximize collaboration, innovation, and productivity among teams and across functions.
   

  

**Benefits** 
 : Our benefits package includes the best of what leading organizations provide, such as paternity/maternity leave, healthcare insurance, broadband reimbursement. As well, when we’re back in the office, we all benefit from a kitchen loaded with healthy snacks and drinks and catered lunches and much more!
   

  

**Diversity and Inclusion** 
 : PubMatic is proud to be an equal opportunity employer; we don’t just value diversity, we promote and celebrate it. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
   

  

**About PubMatic**
 PubMatic is one of the world’s leading scaled digital advertising platforms, offering more transparent advertising solutions to publishers, media buyers, commerce companies and data owners, allowing them to harness the power and potential of the open internet to drive better business outcomes.
   

  

 Founded in 2006 with the vision that data\-driven decisioning would be the future of digital advertising, we enable content creators to run a more profitable advertising business, which in turn allows them to invest back into the multi\-screen and multi\-format content that consumers demand.

**Android TV \& STB Platform Expertise**

* Collaborate with CMS and firmware teams on FOTA\-linked Launcher variant rollout strategies (phase\-based, suffix\-gated).


**Performance, Stability \& Observability**
 Define and own Launcher performance budgets: cold\-start, frame rendering (Janky Frames \<1%), TTID, memory headroom.
 - Drive crash/ANR telemetry analysis pipelines (Perfetto, ANR traces, tombstone parsing, SQLiteException correlation).

- Implement automated regression gates in CI for Launcher performance and stability.

- Architect proactive health dashboards integrating device telemetry, firmware version correlations, and user\-visible error rates.

**AI\-Enabled Launcher Features**
* Lead technical design for AI\-assisted launcher capabilities: semantic app search, contextual recommendations, proactive surfacing.
* Integrate on\-device ML models (TFLite, MediaPipe) for usage prediction and personalization without privacy compromise.
* Design integration points for agentic AI orchestration layers (e.g., JioCortex.AI\-style microservice mesh) within the Launcher context.


**Team Leadership \& Mentoring**
* Lead and mentor a team of 5–10 senior/mid\-level Android engineers across Launcher feature squads.
* Conduct architecture reviews, code reviews, and design critique sessions.
* Define engineering excellence standards: testing pyramid, CI/CD pipelines, and documentation norms.
* Partner with Product, CMS Ops, QA, and Firmware teams to drive end\-to\-end delivery.


**Required Qualifications \& Skills:** 
**DomRequired Skills \& Depth**

* Android TV / STB: Leanback Library, TV Compose, D\-pad/focus engine, Google TV UX guidelines, HDMI\-CEC, 4K rendering

* AI / ML Integration: TFLite, ML Kit, on\-device inference, recommendation pipelines, semantic search embedding
* Architecture: Clean Architecture, MVI/MVVM, modular Gradle, SDK design, API versioning, backward compat strategy
* Testing: JUnit5, Espresso, Robolectric, Compose UI testing, screenshot testing, CI/CD pipelines
* Languages: Kotlin (expert), Java (proficient), C/C\+\+ (working knowledge for NDK/HAL), Python (scripting)


**Experience Requirements**
* Total Android Engineering: 7–10 years
* AOSP Launcher / SystemUI: 5\+ years hands\-on AOSP development
* Android TV / CTV / STB: 4\+ years dedicated Android TV product delivery
* Jetpack Compose: 3\+ years production Compose (phone \+ TV surfaces)
* Technical Leadership: 3\+ years leading Architect or Principal\-level squads
* FOTA / OTA Systems: Experience with firmware lifecycle, phase rollouts, A/B OTA
* Performance Engineering: Demonstrable ownership of Launcher startup/frame budget


**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Google TV certification and GMS compliance processes.

* Exposure to agentic AI platforms or LLM\-based feature integration on Android surfaces.

title: Head of Voice AI Development
description:
You'll own voice AI at JoyzAI. All of it. The real\-time pipeline (audio in, speech understood, LLM reasoning, tools called, speech out), the telephony that gets the call connected, the platform a client uses to configure and run their agent, and the webhooks and CRM plumbing that turn a call into a lead. It's a working product with real clients on it today. Your job is to take it from working to something we'd bet the company on, and to build the team that keeps it that way.
 



 This is a head\-of role at a company of under 15 people, which makes it a player\-coach job. You set the technical direction for voice: what we build on, what we buy, what we rip out. And you write a lot of the code yourself. When a call stutters, drops, or talks over the customer, you're the one who finds out why, fixes it at the root, and changes the system so it can't happen again. When a client wants an agent that does something we've never done, you decide whether the platform can, and then you make it so.
 



  





**What you'll do** 




  





**Own the voice stack** 



* Set the architecture and roadmap for the real\-time calling pipeline: telephony ↔ audio streaming ↔ speech/real\-time models ↔ tool calls ↔ speech out, with latency you can't feel.
* Own the hard voice problems, with opinions earned in production: turn\-taking and barge\-in, silence and voicemail detection, noise and echo, language switching mid\-call (English ↔ Hinglish ↔ regional), and graceful recovery when a model or carrier hiccups.
* Make the build\-vs\-buy calls across STT/TTS, real\-time LLMs, VAD, and telephony carriers. Run the evaluations, own the vendor relationships, decide what we build on next, and know when it's time to switch.
* Design non\-blocking tool calling inside live calls (lookups, bookings, CRM writes) so the agent never goes silent or loses the thread.
* Define what "good" means for a voice agent: the quality bar, the evaluation framework, the test harness. We should know a change made agents better before a client tells us.



  





**Build the platform around the calls** 



* Own the Node.js/Express services and APIs that have to hold up as call volume grows: call orchestration, queueing, webhooks, retries, recording and transcript storage.
* Own the product around the calls: agent configuration (tasks, behaviour, guardrails, AI config), call logs and transcripts, analytics, and bulk\-calling campaign controls.
* Wire calls into the rest of the platform: CRM contacts and tickets, WhatsApp follow\-ups after a call, calendar and booking integrations, Google Sheets and Meta lead\-form ingestion.
* Keep the Angular frontends our team and clients use (the agent configurator, the inbox, the call review screens) clean and usable, whether you're writing them or reviewing them.



  





**Reliability, cost \& scale** 



* Instrument everything: time\-to\-first\-word, per\-call latency breakdowns, drop rates, tool\-call failures, model cost per minute. Own the dashboards that tell us something's wrong before a client does.
* Treat cost per minute as a number you're accountable for. Bring it down without hurting quality: model choice, streaming strategy, caching, carrier routing.
* Own production. Debug incidents on real client calls, reproduce them, fix them at the root, and build the incident and on\-call practice so the next one gets caught faster.



  





**Lead the team** 



* Build and lead the voice engineering team. Hire, set the bar, review the code, and make the engineers around you better.
* Own the engineering standard for voice: architecture decisions, code quality, documentation, what ships and what doesn't.
* Pair with the prompt engineer and customer success on what the platform needs for agents to behave well: new tool types, better fallbacks, a proper test harness for prompts.
* Be the technical authority in front of clients on the hard deployments, the ones where the answer isn't in the docs yet.
* Turn what you learn from client deployments into reusable platform capability, so the next voice agent takes hours to stand up, not days.



  





 Roughly 60% of your time is hands\-on: architecting, coding, debugging live calls, shipping. The other 40% is leading: the team, the roadmap, model and vendor decisions, and the client conversations where the platform's direction gets decided. That ratio shifts toward leading as the team grows, but you never stop being able to open the code and fix it yourself.
 



  





**What we're looking for** 




  





 Three things are non\-negotiable. Please apply only if you meet all three. They're the first thing we screen for.
 



  




* **You have successfully deployed voice AI agents to production, and owned them there.** 
 Not a demo, not a hackathon, not a pilot that quietly ended. A system where real customers spoke to an AI over a phone line or live audio stream, at real volume, for months, and it stayed in production because it worked. You owned the pipeline end to end: streaming audio, speech and real\-time models, latency, interruptions, the failures at 2am, the cost. In our first conversation we'll ask what you shipped, how many calls it handled, what broke, and what you did about it. Come with specifics. Experience at a Voice AI company is a strong signal.



  




* **You can build the whole thing yourself.** 
 Backend services, APIs, real\-time transport, databases, and a frontend a client can use without a walkthrough. You've done this as an individual contributor and you can still do it. A head of voice who can't debug the socket is not who we're hiring.



  




* **You've set the technical direction for a voice product before.** 
 As a founding engineer, tech lead, architect, or head of engineering. The title matters less than the fact that people looked to you for what to build and how, and you were right often enough that the product worked.



  





 Beyond that, we don't care much about degrees or years. We care that you can:
 



  




* Work fluently across the MEAN stack — MongoDB, Express, Angular, Node.js — with TypeScript throughout.
* Design and debug real\-time systems: WebSockets, WebRTC, streaming audio, event\-driven architectures, queues.
* Integrate with telephony/SIP providers and messaging APIs (WhatsApp Business API) and handle their quirks in production.
* Work with LLM APIs, tool/function calling, and speech models, and reason about latency, cost, and failure modes, not just accuracy.
* Design MongoDB data models and APIs for a multi\-tenant SaaS: contacts, conversations, tickets, workflows, role\-based access.
* Hire well, review well, and explain a hard technical call to a founder or a client in plain language.
* Measure and profile before you optimise, write code others can read, and document what you built.



  





 Nice to have: deep experience with real\-time voice frameworks or APIs (OpenAI Realtime, LiveKit, Pipecat, or similar); Indian telephony providers; Hinglish or Indic speech models; GCP/AWS at scale; having scaled a voice product from its first client to serious call volume; having built a voice team from scratch.
 



  





 Full\-time, on\-site in Noida.
 



  





**Why JoyzAI?** 




  





 ✨ Utmost freedom and autonomy — voice AI is yours. Make the decisions, set the direction, do it the way you think is best. We will only suggest.
 



 ✨ Complete responsibility. You are the taskmaster. Take responsibility for it.
 



 ✨ Top\-of\-the\-market pay – we reward high performance with the best packages.
 



 ✨ 5\-day working – weekends are yours to recharge.
 



 ✨ Work from office in Noida – collaborate, learn, and grow with a passionate team.
 



 ✨ High\-growth startup – opportunity to see first hand how AI brings change and be a part of that.

title: QA Engineer (Mobile & Web)
description:
Ryan\-Miranda Partners is a small US\-based software firm.

We build and operate consumer mobile and web applications used by hundreds of thousands of people across iOS, Android, and the browser.

You would join our established India\-based engineering team and report to our lead engineer in Delhi. We work async: a short written plan in the morning, a short written summary in the evening, and very few meetings.

**About the role**

You are the last check before a release reaches users. Our senior developers build the features; your job is to take what they built, run it on every platform, and confirm it works before anyone else sees it. Eventually this role can get promotion.

To be upfront: this is not a feature\-development seat. It is closer to an SDET or release engineer than a manual testing role.

You will read Swift and TypeScript every day, drive three toolchains, and your verification is what lets the rest of the team ship quickly. What you will do

\- Reproduce bugs on real devices, confirm the fix, and check the screens around it

\- Check out branches and run our codebases on three platforms: iOS (Swift/SwiftUI), Android (React Native), and web (TypeScript/React)

\- First\-pass verification of pull requests: run the change on\-device, confirm it does what the ticket says, and write up what you found

\- Manual and regression testing on TestFlight and Google Play internal builds ahead of each release

\- Write clear reproduction steps and test cases in Jira

\- Post a short written plan each morning and a written summary each evening, like the rest of the team

\- Over time, build the automation that replaces your own manual passes: Maestro flows, snapshot suites, and CI checks

title: Mobile App Developer
description:
**Mobile App Developer** 




  





**Location: New Delhi (Work from Office)** 




**Experience: 3–5 Years** 




**Employment Type: Full\-time** 




  





**Who We Are:** 




 PanScience Innovations is India's largest deep\-tech and AI venture studio. Rather than investing in companies from the outside, we co\-found them: we originate the idea, embed a team from day one, and build out the product, technology, go\-to\-market, operations, finance, and legal functions alongside each venture's core team. We've co\-founded 24\+ ventures across healthcare, finance, judiciary, media, and industrial AI, and our role is to take deep science that would otherwise stay in a lab and turn it into a company that can stand on its own.
 



  





**Who you'll Work with:** 




 You'll be looped into multiple portfolio ventures rather than sitting inside just one, working closely with each venture's product and engineering leads and PanScience's central studio functions. You won't be one mobile developer among many on a large team; you'll often own the mobile experience end to end for a venture, and you'll draw on the studio's shared design, backend, and QA resources when you need them.
 



  





**What you'll Do:** 



* Design and build production\-grade cross\-platform apps in Flutter, taking a feature from a wireframe or a rough idea through to something real users rely on daily.
* Own the app end to end: architecture, state management, navigation, offline behaviour, and performance, not just the screens that are easiest to build.
* Integrate with REST/GraphQL APIs and backend services, and work directly with backend engineers to shape contracts rather than just consuming whatever is handed to you.
* Write code that another engineer can pick up without you in the room: clean architecture, sensible state management (Bloc, Riverpod, or Provider), and tests that actually catch regressions.
* Ship to the Play Store and App Store yourself, including release builds, versioning, crash monitoring, and the small platform\-specific details that separate a working app from a polished one.
* Chase down performance issues and jank instead of accepting them as normal, whether that's a slow list, a memory leak, or a startup time that's crept up over releases.
* Push back on scope and native\-plugin shortcuts that will cost the team later; protecting app stability and maintainability is part of the job, not a side effect of it.



  





**What you should Bring:** 



* 3\-5 years of mobile development experience, with at least 1\-2 years building and shipping production Flutter apps that are live on the Play Store and/or App Store today.
* Minimum Qualification: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Strong command of Dart and Flutter fundamentals: widget lifecycle, state management, custom animations, and platform channels for native integrations.
* Working knowledge of native Android (Kotlin/Java) or iOS (Swift) development, enough to debug platform\-specific issues Flutter can't fully abstract away.
* Comfort with the full app lifecycle: CI/CD for mobile, app store submissions, crash reporting (Firebase Crashlytics or similar), and analytics instrumentation.
* Solid grasp of REST/GraphQL integration, local storage (SQLite/Hive/Isar), and secure handling of auth tokens and sensitive user data.
* Comfort moving with limited structure, and a willingness to set up the tooling, conventions, and CI pipeline yourself rather than waiting for someone to hand it to you.



  





**Good to Have:** 



* Experience integrating on\-device ML (TensorFlow Lite, ML Kit) or real\-time features (sockets, push notifications, background sync).
* Exposure to native module development in Kotlin/Swift, or prior experience with React Native, for comparison and migration decisions.



  





**What Success Looks Like:** 




 Within your first few months, you should have shipped at least one release to production that meaningfully improved a real metric — crash\-free rate, load time, retention, or a feature adoption number — and be able to explain plainly what changed and why. Longer term, success means the venture's mobile app is something the team trusts you to own: fewer surprises in production, and a codebase the next engineer can actually build on.

title: Senior iOS Engineer
description:
Ozyn is an AI assistant that does real work. It researches, drives a browser, fills spreadsheets, sends email, and pauses to ask permission before doing anything consequential. It runs today on web, Slack and Telegram.
   

  

 It does not run properly on a phone. That is the single biggest gap in the product, and you would be the person who closes it.
   

  

 THIS IS OUR FIRST MOBILE HIRE
   

  

 You own iOS end to end: the architecture, the code, the App Store Connect account, releases, crash triage, and the decision about what stays web and what goes native. There is no mobile team above you or around you yet — you are the start of one.
   

  

 WHY THE PHONE MATTERS MORE HERE THAN FOR MOST PRODUCTS
   

  

 Ozyn's core interaction is an approval gate: the assistant works for several minutes, then stops and asks before it sends an email or spends money. Today that question arrives on a screen the user may not be looking at. A phone with a working, actionable notification isn't a nice\-to\-have for this product — it's the missing half of the core loop.
   

  

 THE FIRST THIRTY DAYS
   

  

 We want the app live on the App Store within your first month. That is a deliberately hard target and we would rather say so plainly than dress it up: it means shipping the shell we already have, well, rather than building the app you would design from scratch. The native rebuild comes after, informed by real usage.
   

  

 • Week one — Revive the shell, decide which of our two web skins it wraps, and put a TestFlight build on every phone at Tipstat, rough edges included.
   

 • Week two — Sign\-in working on every path: phone OTP, Google and Microsoft native bridges, and Sign in with Apple, which App Store review requires of us because we offer third\-party login. Safe areas and the Dynamic Island handled properly.
   

 • Week three — APNs live end to end: approve or reject a pending agent action from the lock screen, exactly once. Live progress for twenty\-minute runs that survives backgrounding.
   

 • Week four — Through App Store review and publicly live, crash\-free sessions above 99\.5%, and a release process written down so it doesn't live only in your head.
   

  

 THE PROBLEMS THAT MAKE THIS INTERESTING
   

  

 • Runs that outlive the screen — showing live progress across twenty\-minute agent tasks, surviving backgrounding and dropped connections, and reconciling state without ever showing an invented status.
   

 • Approvals as a first\-class mobile object — interactive notifications, idempotent actions, and the design question of how you give someone enough context on a lock screen to safely approve an email they haven't read.
   

 • Handing control back to the human — when our browser agent hits a login wall it asks the user to take over the session. On a desktop that's a window. On a phone it's an open design problem, and yours to answer.
   

 • Voice as a real input, on Indian mobile networks, with honest offline states and no silent data loss.
   

  

 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
   

  

 • 5\+ years building iOS, with at least two apps you shipped to the App Store and then maintained — through review rejections, OS upgrades and crash reports, not just to a v1\.
   

 • Swift and SwiftUI in production, and enough UIKit to know when to reach for it.
   

 • Push notifications done properly: APNs, notification service and content extensions, actionable notifications.
   

 • Comfort with a web view and a JS bridge. Version one wraps our web app. If that offends you on principle we're not a fit; if you can make a hybrid app feel genuinely good and then argue for what should go native, we are.
   

 • You've owned releases: certificates, provisioning, App Store Connect, and at least one rejection you talked your way through.
   

 • You write clearly. You'll be specifying backend work for people who aren't mobile engineers, and that specification is most of the coordination this role needs.
   

  

 Helpful, not required: real\-time and WebSocket\-heavy clients, Firebase Auth, accessibility as a habit rather than a retrofit, and a view on whether Android should be native or cross\-platform next year.
   

  

 Probably not a fit if you want a defined backlog and a mobile team around you, you won't touch the web codebase, or you want to work remotely. This role is on\-site in Bengaluru because the coordination is the job.
   

  

 HOW WE INTERVIEW
   

  

 Four conversations — an intro call, a teardown of an app you built, a practical session where you tell us how you'd get our actual situation to the App Store in a month, and a team and founder conversation. No algorithm puzzles, no unpaid take\-homes. We aim to decide within two weeks.
   

  

 To apply, send a note with links to apps you've shipped — tell us which one you're proudest of and what you'd do differently now.

description:
**Description**
 Payroll Technology at Amazon is all about enabling our business to perform at scale as efficiently as possible with no defects. As Amazon's workforce grows, both in size and geography, Amazon's payroll operations become increasingly complex, and our customers are asked to do more with less. Process can only get them so far, and that's where we come in with technology solutions to integrate and automate systems, detect defects before payment, and provide insights. As an SDE on our team, you will be responsible for leading the architecture, design, development and launch of some of the core product features. You will have significant influence on our overall strategy by helping define these product features, drive the system architecture, and spearhead the best practices to delivery high quality products.
   

  

 The ideal candidate is clearly passionate about new opportunities and has a demonstrated track record of success in delivering new features and products. A commitment to team work, hustle, and strong communication skills (to both business and technical partners) are absolute requirements. You will tackle large complex projects, massive data volume \+ complex business rules in a highly distributed and service\-oriented architecture. You will create reliable, scalable, secure products for our customers in a hyper\-growth environment where priorities shift quickly.
   

  

 This position requires that you are a significant and autonomous contributor. Your work is of consistently high quality. You solve complex problems, applying appropriate technologies and best practices. Your focus is on designing, developing and effectively applying automated solutions that test major portions of software (e.g. significant component, set of features, mid\-size application, service, etc.). You prevent and find defects early. You apply software testing techniques, such as equivalence class partitioning, boundary value testing, etc. You build complete test and/or measurement solutions (e.g. performance, load, scalability, usability, etc.). You use data from testing, deployment, and production to measure quality and provide actionable improvement to the product. You write code that an SDE unfamiliar with the system can understand. You are proficient in a broad range of design approaches and know when it is appropriate to make trade\-offs. Your solutions are pragmatic. You do things with the proper level of complexity the first time, or at least minimize incidental complexity. You consider the legacy of the code you produce, limiting the use of short\-term workarounds. You create flexible software without over\-engineering. You reuse where possible, while being judicious about introducing dependencies. You are efficient with resource usage (e.g. designing to avoid impacting the system under test.)
   

  

**A Day In The Life**
 You are expected to do HLD/LLD of features, code them to Amazon standards, and do code and design reviews. You will attend regular stand\-up meetings and provide your updates. You will keep an eye out for opportunities to improve the product or user experience and suggest those enhancements. You will participate in requirement grooming meetings to ensure the use cases we deliver are complete and functional. You will take your turn at on\-call and own production operational maintenance. You will respond to customer issues and monitor services for healthy execution.

title: Mobile Application Developer
description:
**About Us** 




 BedR India is rebuilding how student and budget housing works in this country — from discovery to day\-to\-day management.
 



 We have two live products in production: a marketplace where students and young professionals find and book PGs and hostels (think Airbnb for budget rentals), and a full\-stack SaaS platform that helps property owners and managers run their operations end\-to\-end — listings, bookings, payments, tenant communication, the works. Real users, real transactions, real growth.
 



 We're now building a Flutter mobile app for the owner side, taking our SaaS into the hands of the people managing these properties on the ground.
 



  
 



**Role Overview** 




 This is a technical leadership role — but leadership here means shipping great code and making the people around you better at doing the same, not sitting in meetings.
 



 You'll be working directly with a team of 3 sharp junior\-to\-mid developers and reporting to the founders. You'll own the architecture, set the technical direction, make the hard calls, and write code yourself every single day. You'll be the most experienced engineer in the room, and that should excite you — not intimidate you.
 



 If you're looking for a role where you can slowly drift away from the keyboard into pure management, this isn't it. If you want to build something from an early stage, have real ownership over technical decisions, and shape what a growing proptech company looks like under the hood — read on.
 



  
 



**What You'll Actually Work On** 




  
 



 Lead the architecture and development of our Flutter mobile app
 



  
 



 Own the technical roadmap across both our marketplace and SaaS products.
 



 Build and optimize backend services — APIs, database design, performance, security.
 



 Make infrastructure decisions on AWS, Docker, and deployment pipelines that can scale with us.
 



 Set code quality standards through reviews, documentation, and hands\-on mentorship with the team.
 



 Work closely with the founders and designers to translate product ideas into well\-engineered features.
 



 Identify and fix bottlenecks before they become crises — and debug them fast when they do.
 



 Be the person who asks "why are we building this?" before asking "how?"
 



  
 



  
 



**The Stack** 




 React · Next.js · Node.js · PostgreSQL · Flutter · AWS · Docker
 



 We don't do rewrites for fun. You'll be working with and improving an existing production codebase — so strong opinions, loosely held, matter more than preferences.
 



  
 



 What We're Looking For
 



  
 



 5–8 years of strong full\-stack engineering experience, with real ownership over architecture and product decisions.
 



 Hands\-on expertise across the stack: Next.js on the frontend, Node.js/Express on the backend, PostgreSQL for data, AWS \+ Docker for infra.
 



 Experience with or a serious willingness to go deep on Flutter — this is non\-negotiable given where we're headed.
 



 A track record of leading or meaningfully mentoring other engineers.
 



 Strong product instincts — you understand that good code that solves the wrong problem is still bad engineering.
 



 A strong technical foundation; we have a lot of respect for people who came up through rigorous CS programs (IITs, NITs, and equivalents), though we care more about what you've built and how you think.
 



 Experience in a startup or early\-stage product environment — or a very clear reason why you're ready for one.
 



  
 



  
 



**Who You Are** 




 You're probably a few years into a solid engineering career and starting to feel like you want more than just tickets to close. You want to own something. You want to make calls. You want to build a team and see it get better over time.
 



 You write code that your future self won't be embarrassed by, and you expect the same from the people around you. You can jump between Flutter and Next.js in the same week without losing context. You've debugged things in production at midnight and learned something from it.
 



 You know the difference between over\-engineering and building to scale — and you can explain that difference clearly to someone who's never thought about it.
 



 And honestly? You're excited about the problem. PG rentals and property management in India are genuinely broken, and you see the opportunity in fixing the infrastructure layer underneath them.
 



  
 



 What We Offer
 



  
 



 A real technical leadership role with full ownership over architecture and engineering culture.
 



 Work directly with the founding team — short feedback loops, fast decisions, no bureaucracy.
 



 An already live platform with real users, so you're building on something real — not starting from zero.
 



 Competitive CTC for the stage we're at, with a possibility of equity.
 



 On\-site in Worli, Mumbai — we work together in person.
 



 The kind of career acceleration that only comes from being early at a company that's going somewhere.

description:
🚀
 **We’re Hiring \| Mobile Performance Marketing – Sales ( Sense Digital)** 




  





**Sense Digital is growing and we’re looking for a strong sales professional to join our Mobile Performance team! If you’re passionate about AdTech, Mobile Apps, Performance Marketing \& New Business** 
 , this could be your next opportunity.
 



  





 📍
 **Location:** 
 Gurgaon
 **(Onsite)** 




 💼
 **Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



 🎯
 **Role:** 
 Mobile App Performance Marketing – Sales
 



  





 What will you be doing?
 



 • Drive
 **new business \& revenue growth** 
 across mobile App performance marketing
 



 • Acquire and build relationships with
 **Direct Advertisers, Brands, App marketers \& Agencies** 




**• Identify and convert new opportunities through prospecting, networking, LinkedIn, referrals \& industry connections** 




**• Engage with Growth, UA \& Performance Marketing teams** 
 to understand their objectives and pitch the right solutions
 



**• Own the sales journey — from prospecting → pitching → negotiation → closure → account growth** 




**• Negotiate budgets, payouts, KPIs and commercials** 




**• Work closely with internal campaign \& operations teams to launch and scale campaigns** 




**• Drive upselling, cross\-selling and long\-term client relationships** 



* Assess client needs and recommend suitable solutions aligned with their business objectives.
* Conduct detailed market research to identify prospective clients by tracking funding rounds, emerging brands, online traffic trends, and competitive landscape.
* Execute daily outreach activities including online and in\-person meetings to generate and nurture leads.
* Present and explain company offerings, including inventories, supply and services through effective decks and discussions.
* Use Excel and basic formulas for data analysis, reporting and pipeline tracking.



  





 We’re looking for someone who has:
 



 ✅ 5–8 years of experience in
 **AdTech / Digital Advertising / Performance Marketing / Affiliate Marketing / Mobile Marketing** 




**✅ Strong understanding of Mobile App Marketing \& User Acquisition** 




**✅ Proven experience in new client acquisition and revenue generation** 




**✅ Strong communication, presentation \& negotiation skills** 




**✅ Existing Advertiser / Agency / App marketer network** 
 is a big plus
 



 ✅ Exposure to MMPs such as
 **AppsFlyer, Adjust, Branch, Singular or Kochava** 
 is preferred
 



 ✅ A strong
 **hunter mindset** 
 \- someone who enjoys opening new doors, building relationships and closing business.
 



  





 About Sense Digital:
 



**Sense Digital** 
 is an established
 **AdTech and digital advertising company with 11\+ years industry** 
 presence across
 **India and the United States** 
 .We work at the intersection of
 **advertising, media and technology** 
 helping advertisers drive measurable growth while enabling publishers to maximize their monetization. Our expertise spans
 **Digital Advertising, Mobile Performance Marketing, Affiliate Marketing and innovative technology\-led solutions** 
 .
 



  





 📩
 **Interested? DM me or share your profile.**
